src.control_plane

Multi-Agent Engineering Control Plane.

Provides task specification, agent capability registry, deterministic routing, specialized independent reviewers, review reconciliation, verification plans, evidence ledgers, transparent performance metrics, project adapters, human authority boundaries, and closed-loop governed task orchestration.

  1"""
  2Multi-Agent Engineering Control Plane.
  3
  4Provides task specification, agent capability registry, deterministic routing,
  5specialized independent reviewers, review reconciliation, verification plans,
  6evidence ledgers, transparent performance metrics, project adapters, human authority boundaries,
  7and closed-loop governed task orchestration.
  8"""
  9

@dataclass
class TaskSpec(src.control_plane.task_spec.DataClassSerializationMixin): 
129@dataclass
130class TaskSpec(DataClassSerializationMixin):
131    """Represents a discrete engineering task handled by the multi-agent control plane."""
132
133    task_id: str
134    repository: str
135    objective: str
136    acceptance_criteria: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
137    constraints: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
138    task_class: str = "feature"
139    risk_level: str = "medium"
140    required_skills: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
141    recommended_reasoning_tier: str = "tier_2"
142    preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None
143    recommended_agent: Optional[str] = None
144    actual_agent: Optional[str] = None
145    is_override: Optional[bool] = None
146    override_reason: Optional[str] = None
147    allowed_tools: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
148    prohibited_actions: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
149    verification_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
150    reviewer_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
151    human_approval_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
152    current_state: str = "discovered"
153    task_journal_path: Optional[str] = None
154    # Exact repo-relative paths this task may commit (#59.2 Phase 8). Empty
155    # (the default) means unrestricted -- existing serialized task.yaml files
156    # without this key deserialize unaffected. When non-empty,
157    # GitIntegrationExecutor.stage_and_commit fails closed on any other path.
158    allowed_paths: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
159    metadata: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
160    schema: str = TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION
161
162    def __post_init__(self):
163        self.validate()
164
165    def validate(self) -> None:
166        """Validates internal fields against allowed enums and non-empty constraints."""
167        if not self.task_id or not isinstance(self.task_id, str):
168            raise TaskSpecValidationError("task_id must be a non-empty string")
169        if not self.repository or not isinstance(self.repository, str):
170            raise TaskSpecValidationError("repository must be a non-empty string")
171        if not self.objective or not isinstance(self.objective, str):
172            raise TaskSpecValidationError("objective must be a non-empty string")
173        if self.task_class not in VALID_TASK_CLASSES:
174            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
175                f"task_class '{self.task_class}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_TASK_CLASSES)}"
176            )
177        if self.risk_level not in VALID_RISK_LEVELS:
178            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
179                f"risk_level '{self.risk_level}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_RISK_LEVELS)}"
180            )
181        if self.recommended_reasoning_tier not in VALID_REASONING_TIERS:
182            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
183                f"recommended_reasoning_tier '{self.recommended_reasoning_tier}' invalid."
184            )
185        if self.current_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
186            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
187                f"current_state '{self.current_state}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_TASK_STATES)}"
188            )
189        if self.schema != TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION:
190            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
191                f"schema '{self.schema}' invalid. Expected '{TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION}'"
192            )
193
194    def transition_to(self, new_state: str, reason: str = "") -> None:
195        """
196        Transitions the task to a new lifecycle state.
197        Raises InvalidStateTransitionError if the transition is illegal.
198        """
199        if new_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
200            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(f"Unknown target state: {new_state}")
201
202        allowed = STATE_TRANSITIONS.get(self.current_state, set())
203        if new_state not in allowed:
204            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(
205                f"Cannot transition task '{self.task_id}' from '{self.current_state}' to '{new_state}'. "
206                f"Allowed transitions from '{self.current_state}': {sorted(allowed)}"
207            )
208
209        self.current_state = new_state
210        if "history" not in self.metadata:
211            self.metadata["history"] = []
212        self.metadata["history"].append(
213            {"to_state": new_state, "reason": reason}
214        )
215
216    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
217        """Converts TaskSpec to dictionary representation."""
218        return asdict(self)
219
220    @classmethod
221    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "TaskSpec":
222        """Constructs a TaskSpec from a dictionary."""
223        d = dict(data)
224        d.pop("schema", None)
225        valid_fields = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
226        filtered = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k in valid_fields}
227        return cls(schema=TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION, **filtered)
228
229    def to_json(self, indent: int = 2) -> str:
230        """Serializes TaskSpec to formatted JSON string."""
231        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=indent)
232
233    @classmethod
234    def from_json(cls, json_str: str) -> "TaskSpec":
235        """Deserializes TaskSpec from JSON string."""
236        data = json.loads(json_str)
237        return cls.from_dict(data)

188    def __init__(self, agents: Optional[List[AgentProfile]] = None):
189        self._agents: Dict[str, AgentProfile] = {}
190        initial = agents if agents is not None else BUILTIN_AGENTS
191        for profile in initial:
192            self.register_agent(profile)
193
194    def register_agent(self, profile: AgentProfile) -> None:
195        """Registers or updates an agent profile."""
196        self._agents[profile.agent_id] = profile

198    def get_agent(self, agent_id: str) -> Optional[AgentProfile]:
199        """Retrieves an agent profile by agent_id."""
200        return self._agents.get(agent_id)
201
202    def list_agents(self, only_available: bool = False) -> List[AgentProfile]:
203        """Lists all registered agent profiles."""
204        agents = list(self._agents.values())
205        if only_available:
206            agents = [a for a in agents if a.availability == "available"]
207        return agents
208
209    def filter_agents(
210        self,
211        capability: Optional[str] = None,
212        reasoning_tier: Optional[str] = None,
213        cost_class: Optional[str] = None,
214        interface: Optional[str] = None,
215        only_available: bool = True,
216    ) -> List[AgentProfile]:
217        """Filters agents matching multiple criteria."""
218        results = self.list_agents(only_available=only_available)
219        if capability:
220            results = [a for a in results if capability in a.capabilities]
221        if reasoning_tier:
222            results = [a for a in results if a.reasoning_tier == reasoning_tier]
223        if cost_class:
224            results = [a for a in results if a.cost_class == cost_class]
225        if interface:
226            results = [a for a in results if a.interface == interface]
227        return results
228
229    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
230        return {
231            "schema": AGENT_REGISTRY_SCHEMA_VERSION,
232            "agents": [a.to_dict() for a in self._agents.values()],
233        }

237        agents_data = data.get("agents", [])

239        return cls(agents=profiles)

529class FakeAgentBackend(AgentBackend):
530    """Deterministic programmable agent backend for automated tests and CI fixtures."""
531
532    def __init__(
533        self,
534        agent_id: str = "fake_agent",
535        default_exit_code: int = 0,
536        default_stdout: str = "Fake implementation completed successfully. No issues found.",
537        default_stderr: str = "",
538        side_effect: Optional[Callable[[TaskSpec, Path, str], None]] = None,
539        duration: float = 0.05,
540    ):
541        self.agent_id = agent_id
542        self.default_exit_code = default_exit_code
543        self.default_stdout = default_stdout
544        self.default_stderr = default_stderr
545        self.side_effect = side_effect
546        self.duration = duration
547        self.executed_calls: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
548
549    def is_available(self) -> bool:
550        return True
551
552    def execute(
553        self,
554        task: TaskSpec,
555        cwd: Union[str, Path],
556        role: str = "implementation",
557        prompt_override: Optional[str] = None,
558        timeout_seconds: int = 300,
559        env_vars: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
560        **kwargs,
561    ) -> AgentExecutionResult:
562        target_cwd = Path(cwd).resolve()
563        prompt = prompt_override or f"Fake execute: {task.objective}"
564        self.executed_calls.append({
565            "task_id": task.task_id if task else "unknown",
566            "role": role,
567            "prompt": prompt,
568            "cwd": str(target_cwd),
569        })
570
571        if self.side_effect:
572            try:
573                self.side_effect(task, target_cwd, prompt)
574            except Exception as exc:
575                return AgentExecutionResult(
576                    agent_id=self.agent_id,
577                    role=role,
578                    command=f"fake_agent({self.agent_id})",
579                    exit_code=1,
580                    stdout="",
581                    stderr=f"Side effect error: {exc}",
582                    duration_seconds=self.duration,
583                    success=False,
584                    error_message=str(exc),
585                )
586
587        ok = (self.default_exit_code == 0)
588        return AgentExecutionResult(
589            agent_id=self.agent_id,
590            role=role,
591            command=f"fake_agent({self.agent_id})",
592            exit_code=self.default_exit_code,
593            stdout=self.default_stdout,
594            stderr=self.default_stderr,
595            duration_seconds=self.duration,
596            success=ok,
597            error_message=None if ok else f"Exit code {self.default_exit_code}",
598        )

class SubprocessAgentBackend(src.control_plane.AgentBackend): 
205class SubprocessAgentBackend(AgentBackend):
206    """Base backend for executing CLI agents via deterministic subprocess execution."""
207
208    def __init__(
209        self,
210        agent_id: str,
211        binary_name: str,
212        cmd_builder: Optional[Callable[[TaskSpec, Path, str, str], List[str]]] = None,
213    ):
214        self.agent_id = agent_id
215        self.binary_name = binary_name
216        self._builder = cmd_builder
217
218    def is_available(self) -> bool:
219        return shutil.which(self.binary_name) is not None
220
221    def build_command(self, task: TaskSpec, cwd: Path, role: str, prompt: str) -> List[str]:
222        if self._builder:
223            return self._builder(task, cwd, role, prompt)
224        return [self.binary_name, prompt]
225
226    def execute(
227        self,
228        task: TaskSpec,
229        cwd: Union[str, Path],
230        role: str = "implementation",
231        prompt_override: Optional[str] = None,
232        timeout_seconds: int = 300,
233        env_vars: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
234        **kwargs,
235    ) -> AgentExecutionResult:
236        target_cwd = Path(cwd).resolve()
237        if not self.is_available():
238            return AgentExecutionResult(
239                agent_id=self.agent_id,
240                role=role,
241                command=self.binary_name,
242                exit_code=127,
243                stdout="",
244                stderr=f"Agent binary '{self.binary_name}' is not installed or available on PATH.",
245                duration_seconds=0.0,
246                success=False,
247                error_message=f"Agent '{self.agent_id}' unavailable",
248            )
249
250        prompt = prompt_override or f"Execute task {task.task_id}: {task.objective}"
251        cmd_args = self.build_command(task, target_cwd, role, prompt)
252        cmd_str = " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd_args)
253
254        env = os.environ.copy()
255        if env_vars:
256            env.update(env_vars)
257
258        start_t = time.time()
259        try:
260            completed = subprocess.run(
261                args=cmd_args,
262                cwd=str(target_cwd),
263                capture_output=True,
264                text=True,
265                env=env,
266                timeout=timeout_seconds,
267            )
268            elapsed = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
269            return AgentExecutionResult(
270                agent_id=self.agent_id,
271                role=role,
272                command=cmd_str,
273                exit_code=completed.returncode,
274                stdout=completed.stdout,
275                stderr=completed.stderr,
276                duration_seconds=elapsed,
277                success=(completed.returncode == 0),
278                error_message=None if completed.returncode == 0 else f"Process exited with code {completed.returncode}",
279            )
280        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
281            dur = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
282            out = exc.stdout.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if exc.stdout else ""
283            err = exc.stderr.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if exc.stderr else ""
284            return AgentExecutionResult(
285                agent_id=self.agent_id,
286                role=role,
287                command=cmd_str,
288                exit_code=-1,
289                stdout=out,
290                stderr=err + f"\nTimeout after {timeout_seconds}s.",
291                duration_seconds=dur,
292                success=False,
293                timed_out=True,
294                error_message=f"Timeout after {timeout_seconds}s",
295            )
296        except Exception as exc:
297            dur = round(time.time() - start_t, 3)
298            return AgentExecutionResult(
299                agent_id=self.agent_id,
300                role=role,
301                command=cmd_str,
302                exit_code=-1,
303                stdout="",
304                stderr=str(exc),
305                duration_seconds=dur,
306                success=False,
307                error_message=str(exc),
308            )

def execute( self, task: TaskSpec, cwd: Union[str, pathlib.Path], role: str = 'implementation', prompt_override: Optional[str] = None, timeout_seconds: int = 300, env_vars: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, **kwargs) -> AgentExecutionResult: 
226    def execute(
227        self,
228        task: TaskSpec,
229        cwd: Union[str, Path],
230        role: str = "implementation",
231        prompt_override: Optional[str] = None,
232        timeout_seconds: int = 300,
233        env_vars: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
234        **kwargs,
235    ) -> AgentExecutionResult:
236        target_cwd = Path(cwd).resolve()
237        if not self.is_available():
238            return AgentExecutionResult(
239                agent_id=self.agent_id,

248            )
249
250        prompt = prompt_override or f"Execute task {task.task_id}: {task.objective}"
251        cmd_args = self.build_command(task, target_cwd, role, prompt)
252        cmd_str = " ".join(shlex.quote(c) for c in cmd_args)
253
254        env = os.environ.copy()
255        if env_vars:
256            env.update(env_vars)
257
258        start_t = time.time()

279            )

284            return AgentExecutionResult(

def capture_baseline( repo_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path]) -> GitBaseline: 
81def capture_baseline(repo_dir: Union[str, Path]) -> GitBaseline:
82    """Captures the initial state of the repository prior to task execution."""
83    root = Path(repo_dir).resolve()
84    sha_proc = _run_git_cmd(root, ["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
85    sha = sha_proc.stdout.strip() if sha_proc.returncode == 0 else "HEAD_UNKNOWN"
86
87    status_out = _run_git_cmd(root, ["status", "--porcelain"]).stdout or ""
88    untracked, modified, _, _ = _parse_porcelain_lines(status_out)
89
90    return GitBaseline(
91        repo_root=str(root),
92        initial_commit_sha=sha,
93        status_porcelain=status_out,
94        pre_existing_modified=sorted(list(modified)),
95        pre_existing_untracked=sorted(list(untracked)),
96    )

Captures the initial state of the repository prior to task execution.

def capture_delta( repo_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path], baseline: GitBaseline) -> RepositoryDelta: 
112def capture_delta(repo_dir: Union[str, Path], baseline: GitBaseline) -> RepositoryDelta:
113    """Computes task-attributable repository delta, isolating pre-existing dirt."""
114    root = Path(repo_dir).resolve()
115    status_out = _run_git_cmd(root, ["status", "--porcelain"]).stdout or ""
116    cur_untracked, cur_modified, cur_deleted, cur_added = _parse_porcelain_lines(status_out)
117
118    pre_untracked = set(baseline.pre_existing_untracked)
119    pre_modified = set(baseline.pre_existing_modified)
120
121    task_added = sorted(list((cur_untracked - pre_untracked) | (cur_added - pre_modified)))
122    task_deleted = sorted(list(cur_deleted - pre_modified))
123    task_modified = sorted(list(cur_modified - pre_modified))
124    excluded = sorted(list((cur_untracked & pre_untracked) | (cur_modified & pre_modified)))
125
126    diffs: List[str] = []
127    tracked_changed = sorted(list(set(task_modified + task_deleted + [f for f in task_added if f in cur_added])))
128    if tracked_changed:
129        d_proc = _run_git_cmd(root, ["diff", "HEAD", "--"] + tracked_changed)
130        if d_proc.returncode == 0 and d_proc.stdout.strip():
131            diffs.append(d_proc.stdout.strip())
132
133    for nf in task_added:
134        if nf in cur_untracked:
135            ch = _generate_untracked_diff(root, nf)
136            if ch.strip():
137                diffs.append(ch.strip())
138
139    full_diff = "\n\n".join(diffs) if diffs else ""
140    ins = sum(1 for l in full_diff.splitlines() if l.startswith("+") and not l.startswith("+++"))
141    dels = sum(1 for l in full_diff.splitlines() if l.startswith("-") and not l.startswith("---"))
142
143    return RepositoryDelta(
144        files_added=task_added,
145        files_modified=task_modified,
146        files_deleted=task_deleted,
147        diff_content=full_diff,
148        insertions=ins,
149        deletions=dels,
150        is_empty=not bool(task_added or task_modified or task_deleted or full_diff.strip()),
151        pre_existing_excluded=excluded,
152    )

Computes task-attributable repository delta, isolating pre-existing dirt.

class TaskRouter: 
 48class TaskRouter:
 49    """
 50    Deterministic task router that matches task specifications to agent capabilities
 51    without making external API calls.
 52    """
 53
 54    def __init__(self, registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None):
 55        self.registry = registry or AgentRegistry()
 56
 57    def route(self, task: TaskSpec) -> RoutingDecision:
 58        """
 59        Calculates the recommended agent and reviewers for a given task specification.
 60        """
 61        reviewers, reviewer_reasons = self._select_reviewers(task)
 62
 63        # 1. Check for human / policy override
 64        if task.preferred_agent:
 65            target = self.registry.get_agent(task.preferred_agent)
 66            if target:
 67                if target.availability == "available":
 68                    return RoutingDecision(
 69                        selected_agent_id=target.agent_id,
 70                        selected_agent_name=target.name,
 71                        reasoning_tier=target.reasoning_tier,
 72                        rationale=(
 73                            f"User/policy override explicitly requested agent '{target.agent_id}' ({target.name})."
 74                        ),
 75                        recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
 76                        reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
 77                        is_override=True,
 78                        alternatives=[
 79                            a.agent_id
 80                            for a in self.registry.list_agents(only_available=True)
 81                            if a.agent_id != target.agent_id
 82                        ],
 83                    )
 84
 85        # 2. Evaluate task risk, skills, and reasoning requirements
 86        available_agents = self.registry.list_agents(only_available=True)
 87        if not available_agents:
 88            raise RuntimeError("No available agents found in the registry.")
 89
 90        skills = set(task.required_skills)
 91        is_security = bool(
 92            skills.intersection({"cyber_security", "blue_team", "red_team", "bug_bounty_hunter"})
 93        )
 94        is_arch = bool(
 95            skills.intersection({"architectural_guardrails", "systems_logic", "technical_writing"})
 96        )
 97        is_autonomous = "autonomous_workflow" in task.allowed_tools or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical")
 98
 99        # 3. Apply deterministic decision matrix
100        selected_agent: Optional[AgentProfile] = None
101        rationale_lines: List[str] = []
102
103        if task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_1" or task.risk_level in ("high", "critical") or is_security or is_arch:
104            # Tier 1 reasoning candidates
105            tier_1_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_1"]
106            if tier_1_agents:
107                # Prefer claude_code if orchestration/architecture, devin_cli if autonomous
108                if is_autonomous and any(a.agent_id == "devin_cli" for a in tier_1_agents):
109                    selected_agent = next(a for a in tier_1_agents if a.agent_id == "devin_cli")
110                    rationale_lines.append(
111                        "Selected Devin CLI for autonomous multi-step execution under high risk/tier 1 constraints."
112                    )
113                else:
114                    selected_agent = tier_1_agents[0]
115                    rationale_lines.append(
116                        f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for Tier 1 reasoning, architectural depth, and risk handling."
117                    )
118            else:
119                # Fall back to strongest Tier 2 agent
120                tier_2_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
121                selected_agent = tier_2_agents[0] if tier_2_agents else available_agents[0]
122                rationale_lines.append(
123                    f"Tier 1 requested but unavailable; routed to highest available Tier 2 agent: {selected_agent.name}."
124                )
125
126        elif task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_3" and task.risk_level == "low":
127            # Local / low-cost candidates
128            local_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.cost_class == "free_local"]
129            if local_agents:
130                selected_agent = local_agents[0]
131                rationale_lines.append(
132                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} to minimize cost and preserve session limits for low-risk Tier 3 work."
133                )
134            else:
135                selected_agent = available_agents[0]
136                rationale_lines.append(
137                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for low-risk standard execution."
138                )
139
140        else:
141            # Standard Tier 2 implementation
142            tier_2_agents = [a for a in available_agents if a.reasoning_tier == "tier_2"]
143            if tier_2_agents:
144                # If headless delegation is allowed, prefer agy
145                if "headless_cli" in [a.interface for a in tier_2_agents]:
146                    selected_agent = next(
147                        (a for a in tier_2_agents if a.interface == "headless_cli"),
148                        tier_2_agents[0],
149                    )
150                else:
151                    selected_agent = tier_2_agents[0]
152                rationale_lines.append(
153                    f"Selected {selected_agent.name} for balanced standard implementation (Tier 2)."
154                )
155            else:
156                selected_agent = available_agents[0]
157                rationale_lines.append(f"Selected {selected_agent.name} as best available general agent.")
158
159        # Build alternatives list
160        alternatives = [a.agent_id for a in available_agents if a.agent_id != selected_agent.agent_id]
161
162        return RoutingDecision(
163            selected_agent_id=selected_agent.agent_id,
164            selected_agent_name=selected_agent.name,
165            reasoning_tier=selected_agent.reasoning_tier,
166            rationale=" ".join(rationale_lines),
167            recommended_reviewers=reviewers,
168            reviewer_selection_reasons=reviewer_reasons,
169            is_override=False,
170            alternatives=alternatives,
171        )
172
173    def _select_reviewers(self, task: TaskSpec) -> Tuple[List[str], Dict[str, str]]:
174        """
175        Determines the specialized reviewer roles required for the task and records explicit rationales.
176        """
177        reviewers: List[str] = []
178        reasons: Dict[str, str] = {}
179
180        def add_reviewer(role: str, reason: str):
181            if role not in reviewers:
182                reviewers.append(role)
183                reasons[role] = reason
184
185        # Baseline reviewers for all tasks
186        add_reviewer("correctness-reviewer", "Baseline correctness, edge cases, and acceptance contract verification.")
187        add_reviewer("test-falsifier", "Adversarial test verification, missing negative branch and vacuous assertion checks.")
188
189        # If user explicitly listed reviewer requirements in task spec, merge them
190        if task.reviewer_requirements:
191            for req in task.reviewer_requirements:
192                add_reviewer(req, "Explicitly required by TaskSpec reviewer_requirements.")
193
194        skills = set(task.required_skills)
195        if task.risk_level in ("high", "critical") or skills.intersection(
196            {"cyber_security", "blue_team", "red_team", "bug_bounty_hunter"}
197        ):
198            add_reviewer("security-reviewer", "Triggered by high/critical risk level or security-related skill requirements.")
199
200        if skills.intersection({"architectural_guardrails", "systems_logic", "technical_writing"}) or task.recommended_reasoning_tier == "tier_1":
201            add_reviewer("architecture-reviewer", "Triggered by Tier 1 reasoning requirement or architectural skill requirements.")
202
203        if task.risk_level in ("medium", "high", "critical"):
204            add_reviewer("regression-reviewer", "Triggered by medium/high/critical risk scope to protect existing contracts and call sites.")
205
206        # Simplicity reviewer for refactoring or multi-file work
207        add_reviewer("simplicity-reviewer", "Minimal diff review to prevent overengineering and eliminate dead code.")
208
209        return reviewers, reasons

Deterministic task router that matches task specifications to agent capabilities without making external API calls.

18class RoutingDecision:
19    """Represents the output of the task routing determination."""
20
21    selected_agent_id: str
22    selected_agent_name: str
23    reasoning_tier: str
24    rationale: str

31    def render_text(self, task_id: str = "") -> str:

REVIEWER_ROLES = {'correctness-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='correctness-reviewer', name='Correctness Reviewer', focus_areas=['correctness', 'edge_cases', 'contract_compliance', 'error_handling'], falsification_goal='Produce a concrete input or state where code violates requirements, fails on edge cases, or contains logic bugs.', prompt_template='You are an independent Correctness Reviewer. Your role is strictly adversarial to buggy code.\nDo NOT assume the code works just because it appears clean or passes basic tests.\nYour primary objective is to produce a concrete input, state, or execution path where behavior violates requirements or logic:\n1. Logic bugs, off-by-one errors, inverse condition checks, incorrect boolean logic.\n2. Unhandled edge cases (None/null, empty collections, negative numbers, timeouts, unexpected types).\n3. Mismatches where the code fails to strictly fulfill an acceptance criterion.\n4. Broken error handling or swallowed exceptions that mask underlying failures.\n5. Incomplete state transitions or unhandled error recovery states.\n'), 'regression-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='regression-reviewer', name='Regression Reviewer', focus_areas=['regression', 'backwards_compatibility', 'call_sites', 'contract_drift'], falsification_goal='Identify previously valid behavior, caller contracts, or configurations broken by this change.', prompt_template='You are an independent Regression Reviewer. Your job is to protect existing functionality from breakage.\nDo NOT evaluate whether the new feature is nice; evaluate what previously valid behavior is now broken.\nSearch specifically for:\n1. Breaking changes to function/method signatures, interfaces, or return types.\n2. Deleted or renamed attributes/variables still referenced elsewhere in the repository.\n3. Behavior changes for existing callers under default parameters or existing workflows.\n4. Schema migrations, configuration drifts, or altered environment assumptions.\n5. Inadvertently altered public contracts or library APIs.\n'), 'security-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='security-reviewer', name='Security Reviewer', focus_areas=['security', 'vulnerabilities', 'credentials', 'injection', 'authorization'], falsification_goal='Identify trust-boundary violations, unsafe execution, secret exposure, authorization gaps, or fail-open logic.', prompt_template='You are an independent Security Reviewer. Your job is to identify security vulnerabilities, credential leaks, and unsafe patterns.\nAttempt to identify trust-boundary violations, unsafe execution, secret exposure, authorization gaps, injection surfaces, or fail-open behavior:\n1. Hardcoded secrets, API keys, credentials, PII, or internal tokens.\n2. Unsafe command execution, unescaped shell interpolations (`shell=True`, bash backtick injection, subprocess without list args).\n3. Missing input validation, path traversal (`../`), unconstrained deserialization, or unvalidated file writes.\n4. Authorization flaws, bypasses of human approval gates, or fail-open authorization logic.\n5. Insecure defaults or sensitive data leakage in logs or exceptions.\n'), 'test-falsifier': ReviewerRole(role_id='test-falsifier', name='Test Falsifier', focus_areas=['test_gap', 'vacuous_tests', 'mock_fidelity', 'untested_branches'], falsification_goal='Prove the test suite is inadequate or construct a broken implementation that still passes tests.', prompt_template="You are an independent Test Falsifier. Your mission is to prove that the tests are insufficient, illusory, or vacuous.\nDo NOT celebrate green tests. Attempt to create a broken implementation that would still pass the current tests:\n1. Tests that pass vacuously (e.g. asserting `True`, asserting on mocked objects without calling real code).\n2. Mock paths that don't match reality (e.g. patching an object where it's defined rather than where it's imported, or over-mocking).\n3. Missing negative test cases: error paths, timeouts, boundary inputs, malformed schemas, fail-closed assertions.\n4. Code implementations that pass the test suite while violating the true task requirements.\n"), 'architecture-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='architecture-reviewer', name='Architecture Reviewer', focus_areas=['architecture', 'coupling', 'abstraction_quality', 'boundary_discipline'], falsification_goal='Identify structural coupling, leaky abstractions, and layering violations that materially raise risk.', prompt_template="You are an independent Architecture Reviewer. Your role is to maintain system integrity and prevent architectural erosion.\nIdentify boundary violations or coupling that materially raises maintenance or correctness risk:\n1. Unnecessary coupling between unrelated modules or circular dependencies.\n2. Leaky abstractions or single-caller abstractions that add indirection without value.\n3. Violations of the repository's established layer boundaries (e.g. domain vs infrastructure vs orchestration).\n4. Code that should live in a reusable module but was copy-pasted across multiple locations.\nNOTE: Do NOT complain about style unless it materially affects architecture or correctness.\n"), 'simplicity-reviewer': ReviewerRole(role_id='simplicity-reviewer', name='Simplicity Reviewer', focus_areas=['simplicity', 'minimal_diff', 'complexity_elimination', 'dead_code'], falsification_goal='Prove the solution contains unnecessary moving parts and find smaller, simpler alternatives.', prompt_template='You are an independent Simplicity Reviewer. Overengineered solutions where a simple built-in or shorter function suffices.\n2. Dead code, unused arguments, premature generalizations, or speculative features.\n3. Opportunities to solve the same problem with significantly fewer lines of diff.\n4. Redundant boilerplate that obscures business logic.\nNOTE: Do NOT propose rewrites merely for elegance; focus on removing actual excess complexity.\n')}

class ReviewRunner: 
374class ReviewRunner:
375    """Orchestrates independent review runs, output parsing, and reconciliation."""
376
377    @classmethod
378    def execute_review_cycle(
379        cls,
380        task: TaskSpec,
381        diff_content: str,
382        reviewer_roles: List[str],
383        cwd: Union[str, Path],
384        backend: Optional[AgentBackend] = None,
385        cycle_index: int = 1,
386        reviewer_agent_mapping: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
387        custom_reviewer_fn: Optional[Callable[[str, str, TaskSpec], str]] = None,
388        run_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
389        provider_pool: Optional[Any] = None,
390    ) -> ReviewCycleResult:
391        """
392        Executes each specified reviewer independently against the actual implementation diff.
393        Preserves already-completed reviewer artifacts from previous interrupted runs.
394
395        `provider_pool` is optional (#59.2 Phase 4): when supplied, a reviewer
396        whose primary assignment fails, times out, or produces invalid output
397        gets one bounded fallback attempt against an independent candidate via
398        `invoke_reviewer_with_failover`, mirroring implementation failover.
399        Omitting it (the default, and the only behavior any caller exercised
400        before #59.2) preserves the prior single-attempt-per-role behavior
401        exactly.
402        """
403        target_cwd = Path(cwd).resolve()
404        reviewer_results: Dict[str, SingleReviewResult] = {}
405        all_findings: List[ReviewFinding] = []
406        has_failure = False
407
408        skill_context = build_skill_context(task)
409
410        # Establish cycle directory for incremental checkpointing
411        cycle_dir: Optional[Path] = None
412        if run_dir:
413            r_path = Path(run_dir).resolve()
414            if cycle_index == 1:
415                cycle_dir = r_path / "reviews"
416            else:
417                cycle_dir = r_path / "remediation" / f"cycle-{cycle_index - 1:02d}" / "re_review"
418            cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
419
420        for role_id in reviewer_roles:
421            role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
422            role_name = role.name if role else role_id
423
424            # Check if this reviewer already completed in a previous interrupted run
425            cached_result: Optional[SingleReviewResult] = None
426            if cycle_dir:
427                cached_md = cycle_dir / f"{role_id}.md"
428                cached_yaml = cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml"
429                if cached_md.is_file() and cached_yaml.is_file():
430                    try:
431                        c_raw = cached_md.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
432                        raw_data = yaml.safe_load(cached_yaml.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or []
433                        if isinstance(raw_data, dict):
434                            c_findings_data = raw_data.get("findings", [])
435                        elif isinstance(raw_data, list):
436                            c_findings_data = raw_data
437                        else:
438                            c_findings_data = []
439                        c_findings = [
440                            ReviewFinding.from_dict(f) if isinstance(f, dict) else f
441                            for f in c_findings_data
442                        ]
443                        cached_result = SingleReviewResult(
444                            reviewer_role=role_id,
445                            reviewer_name=role_name,
446                            status="findings_detected" if c_findings else "clean",
447                            findings=c_findings,
448                            raw_output=c_raw,
449                            error_message=None,
450                            duration_seconds=0.0,
451                        )
452                    except Exception:
453                        cached_result = None
454
455            if cached_result is not None:
456                reviewer_results[role_id] = cached_result
457                all_findings.extend(cached_result.findings)
458                continue
459
460            # Render brief with the REAL implementation diff and skill context
461            brief = (
462                role.render_brief(task=task, diff_content=diff_content, context=skill_context)
463                if role
464                else f"# Review Brief for {role_id}\n{skill_context or ''}\n```diff\n{diff_content}\n```"
465            )
466
467            raw_output = ""
468            err_message = None
469            agent_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None
470            duration = 0.0
471
472            attempts_log: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
473            if custom_reviewer_fn:
474                try:
475                    raw_output = custom_reviewer_fn(role_id, diff_content, task)
476                except Exception as exc:
477                    err_message = str(exc)
478                    has_failure = True
479            elif provider_pool is not None and not backend:
480                agent_id = (reviewer_agent_mapping or {}).get(role_id) or "claude_code"
481                candidates = build_reviewer_candidates(role_id, agent_id, provider_pool, task)
482                winner, agent_res, attempts_log = invoke_reviewer_with_failover(
483                    role_id=role_id,
484                    candidates=candidates,
485                    task=task,
486                    cwd=target_cwd,
487                    prompt_override=brief,
488                    backend_lookup=lambda aid: AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(aid),
489                    provider_pool=provider_pool,
490                )
491                duration = agent_res.duration_seconds if agent_res else 0.0
492                if winner and agent_res:
493                    raw_output = agent_res.stdout
494                else:
495                    err_message = "All candidate reviewers failed or were unavailable"
496                    has_failure = True
497            else:
498                agent_id = (reviewer_agent_mapping or {}).get(role_id) or "claude_code"
499                selected_backend = backend or AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(agent_id)
500                agent_res = selected_backend.execute(
501                    task=task,
502                    cwd=target_cwd,
503                    role=role_id,
504                    prompt_override=brief,
505                    timeout_seconds=REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
506                )
507                duration = agent_res.duration_seconds
508                if agent_res.success:
509                    raw_output = agent_res.stdout
510                else:
511                    err_message = agent_res.stderr or agent_res.error_message
512                    has_failure = True
513
514            findings, parse_err, is_valid_output = parse_and_validate_findings(raw_output, role_id)
515            if parse_err:
516                has_failure = True
517                status = "malformed_output"
518            elif err_message:
519                status = "reviewer_failure"
520            elif findings:
521                status = "findings_detected"
522            elif not is_valid_output:
523                has_failure = True
524                status = "output_invalid"
525            else:
526                status = "clean"
527
528            single_res = SingleReviewResult(
529                reviewer_role=role_id,
530                reviewer_name=role_name,
531                status=status,
532                findings=findings,
533                raw_output=raw_output,
534                error_message=err_message or parse_err,
535                duration_seconds=duration,
536                agent_result=agent_res,
537                attempts=attempts_log,
538            )
539            reviewer_results[role_id] = single_res
540            all_findings.extend(findings)
541
542            # Persist individual reviewer artifact incrementally
543            if cycle_dir:
544                try:
545                    from src.control_plane.atomic_io import atomic_write_text, atomic_write_yaml
546                    atomic_write_text(cycle_dir / f"{role_id}.md", raw_output)
547                    atomic_write_yaml(
548                        cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml",
549                        [f.to_dict() for f in findings],
550                        sort_keys=False,
551                    )
552                except Exception:
553                    pass
554
555        # Run reconciliation across all gathered findings
556        reconciliation = ReviewReconciler.reconcile(all_findings) if all_findings else None
557
558        # Check if remediation is needed: unresolved blockers > 0, unresolved highs
559        # > 0, or any reviewer failed to complete (#59.2 Phase 3). A reviewer that
560        # never ran/parsed successfully must never be silently indistinguishable
561        # from "ran cleanly, found nothing" -- has_failure alone must gate here,
562        # independent of whether any findings exist to reconcile.
563        requires_remediation = False
564        if has_failure:
565            requires_remediation = True
566        if reconciliation:
567            if reconciliation.unresolved_blockers > 0 or reconciliation.unresolved_highs > 0:
568                requires_remediation = True
569            elif reconciliation.confirmed or reconciliation.likely:
570                requires_remediation = True
571
572        overall_status = "review_failure" if has_failure else ("has_findings" if all_findings else "clean")
573
574        return ReviewCycleResult(
575            cycle_index=cycle_index,
576            reviewer_results=reviewer_results,
577            all_findings=all_findings,
578            reconciliation=reconciliation,
579            status=overall_status,
580            requires_remediation=requires_remediation,
581        )
582
583    @classmethod
584    def determine_re_review_roles(
585        cls,
586        findings: List[ReviewFinding],
587        original_roles: List[str],
588    ) -> List[str]:
589        """
590        Deterministically selects targeted reviewers for re-review after remediation.
591        """
592        if not findings:
593            return list(original_roles)
594
595        selected: Set[str] = set()
596        for f in findings:
597            cat = (f.category or "").lower()
598            role = f.reviewer_role
599
600            if role:
601                selected.add(role)
602
603            if cat in ("security", "vuln", "auth"):
604                selected.update(["security-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer", "test-falsifier"])
605            elif cat in ("architecture", "coupling", "boundary"):
606                selected.update(["architecture-reviewer", "regression-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer"])
607            elif cat in ("regression", "breaking_change"):
608                selected.update(["regression-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer"])
609            elif cat in ("test_gap", "missing_test", "vacuous_test"):
610                selected.update(["test-falsifier", "correctness-reviewer"])
611            elif cat in ("simplicity", "complexity", "dead_code"):
612                selected.update(["simplicity-reviewer", "correctness-reviewer"])
613            else:
614                selected.update(["correctness-reviewer", "test-falsifier"])
615
616        # Filter against available original roles or known reviewer roles
617        target_roles = [r for r in original_roles if r in selected]
618        if not target_roles:
619            target_roles = list(selected)
620        return sorted(list(set(target_roles)))

Orchestrates independent review runs, output parsing, and reconciliation.

@classmethod
def execute_review_cycle( cls, task: TaskSpec, diff_content: str, reviewer_roles: List[str], cwd: Union[str, pathlib.Path], backend: Optional[AgentBackend] = None, cycle_index: int = 1, reviewer_agent_mapping: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None, custom_reviewer_fn: Optional[Callable[[str, str, TaskSpec], str]] = None, run_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path, NoneType] = None, provider_pool: Optional[Any] = None) -> ReviewCycleResult: 
377    @classmethod
378    def execute_review_cycle(
379        cls,
380        task: TaskSpec,
381        diff_content: str,
382        reviewer_roles: List[str],
383        cwd: Union[str, Path],
384        backend: Optional[AgentBackend] = None,
385        cycle_index: int = 1,
386        reviewer_agent_mapping: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
387        custom_reviewer_fn: Optional[Callable[[str, str, TaskSpec], str]] = None,
388        run_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
389        provider_pool: Optional[Any] = None,
390    ) -> ReviewCycleResult:
391        """
392        Executes each specified reviewer independently against the actual implementation diff.
393        Preserves already-completed reviewer artifacts from previous interrupted runs.
394
395        `provider_pool` is optional (#59.2 Phase 4): when supplied, a reviewer
396        whose primary assignment fails, times out, or produces invalid output
397        gets one bounded fallback attempt against an independent candidate via
398        `invoke_reviewer_with_failover`, mirroring implementation failover.
399        Omitting it (the default, and the only behavior any caller exercised
400        before #59.2) preserves the prior single-attempt-per-role behavior
401        exactly.
402        """
403        target_cwd = Path(cwd).resolve()
404        reviewer_results: Dict[str, SingleReviewResult] = {}
405        all_findings: List[ReviewFinding] = []
406        has_failure = False
407
408        skill_context = build_skill_context(task)
409
410        # Establish cycle directory for incremental checkpointing
411        cycle_dir: Optional[Path] = None
412        if run_dir:
413            r_path = Path(run_dir).resolve()
414            if cycle_index == 1:
415                cycle_dir = r_path / "reviews"
416            else:
417                cycle_dir = r_path / "remediation" / f"cycle-{cycle_index - 1:02d}" / "re_review"
418            cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
419
420        for role_id in reviewer_roles:
421            role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
422            role_name = role.name if role else role_id
423
424            # Check if this reviewer already completed in a previous interrupted run
425            cached_result: Optional[SingleReviewResult] = None
426            if cycle_dir:
427                cached_md = cycle_dir / f"{role_id}.md"
428                cached_yaml = cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml"
429                if cached_md.is_file() and cached_yaml.is_file():
430                    try:
431                        c_raw = cached_md.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
432                        raw_data = yaml.safe_load(cached_yaml.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) or []
433                        if isinstance(raw_data, dict):
434                            c_findings_data = raw_data.get("findings", [])
435                        elif isinstance(raw_data, list):
436                            c_findings_data = raw_data
437                        else:
438                            c_findings_data = []
439                        c_findings = [
440                            ReviewFinding.from_dict(f) if isinstance(f, dict) else f
441                            for f in c_findings_data
442                        ]
443                        cached_result = SingleReviewResult(
444                            reviewer_role=role_id,
445                            reviewer_name=role_name,
446                            status="findings_detected" if c_findings else "clean",
447                            findings=c_findings,
448                            raw_output=c_raw,
449                            error_message=None,
450                            duration_seconds=0.0,
451                        )
452                    except Exception:
453                        cached_result = None
454
455            if cached_result is not None:
456                reviewer_results[role_id] = cached_result
457                all_findings.extend(cached_result.findings)
458                continue
459
460            # Render brief with the REAL implementation diff and skill context
461            brief = (
462                role.render_brief(task=task, diff_content=diff_content, context=skill_context)
463                if role
464                else f"# Review Brief for {role_id}\n{skill_context or ''}\n```diff\n{diff_content}\n```"
465            )
466
467            raw_output = ""
468            err_message = None
469            agent_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None
470            duration = 0.0
471
472            attempts_log: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
473            if custom_reviewer_fn:
474                try:
475                    raw_output = custom_reviewer_fn(role_id, diff_content, task)
476                except Exception as exc:
477                    err_message = str(exc)
478                    has_failure = True
479            elif provider_pool is not None and not backend:
480                agent_id = (reviewer_agent_mapping or {}).get(role_id) or "claude_code"
481                candidates = build_reviewer_candidates(role_id, agent_id, provider_pool, task)
482                winner, agent_res, attempts_log = invoke_reviewer_with_failover(
483                    role_id=role_id,
484                    candidates=candidates,
485                    task=task,
486                    cwd=target_cwd,
487                    prompt_override=brief,
488                    backend_lookup=lambda aid: AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(aid),
489                    provider_pool=provider_pool,
490                )
491                duration = agent_res.duration_seconds if agent_res else 0.0
492                if winner and agent_res:
493                    raw_output = agent_res.stdout
494                else:
495                    err_message = "All candidate reviewers failed or were unavailable"
496                    has_failure = True
497            else:
498                agent_id = (reviewer_agent_mapping or {}).get(role_id) or "claude_code"
499                selected_backend = backend or AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(agent_id)
500                agent_res = selected_backend.execute(
501                    task=task,
502                    cwd=target_cwd,
503                    role=role_id,
504                    prompt_override=brief,
505                    timeout_seconds=REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
506                )
507                duration = agent_res.duration_seconds
508                if agent_res.success:
509                    raw_output = agent_res.stdout
510                else:
511                    err_message = agent_res.stderr or agent_res.error_message
512                    has_failure = True
513
514            findings, parse_err, is_valid_output = parse_and_validate_findings(raw_output, role_id)
515            if parse_err:
516                has_failure = True
517                status = "malformed_output"
518            elif err_message:
519                status = "reviewer_failure"
520            elif findings:
521                status = "findings_detected"
522            elif not is_valid_output:
523                has_failure = True
524                status = "output_invalid"
525            else:
526                status = "clean"
527
528            single_res = SingleReviewResult(
529                reviewer_role=role_id,
530                reviewer_name=role_name,
531                status=status,
532                findings=findings,
533                raw_output=raw_output,
534                error_message=err_message or parse_err,
535                duration_seconds=duration,
536                agent_result=agent_res,
537                attempts=attempts_log,
538            )
539            reviewer_results[role_id] = single_res
540            all_findings.extend(findings)
541
542            # Persist individual reviewer artifact incrementally
543            if cycle_dir:
544                try:
545                    from src.control_plane.atomic_io import atomic_write_text, atomic_write_yaml
546                    atomic_write_text(cycle_dir / f"{role_id}.md", raw_output)
547                    atomic_write_yaml(
548                        cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml",
549                        [f.to_dict() for f in findings],
550                        sort_keys=False,
551                    )
552                except Exception:
553                    pass
554
555        # Run reconciliation across all gathered findings
556        reconciliation = ReviewReconciler.reconcile(all_findings) if all_findings else None
557
558        # Check if remediation is needed: unresolved blockers > 0, unresolved highs
559        # > 0, or any reviewer failed to complete (#59.2 Phase 3). A reviewer that
560        # never ran/parsed successfully must never be silently indistinguishable
561        # from "ran cleanly, found nothing" -- has_failure alone must gate here,
562        # independent of whether any findings exist to reconcile.
563        requires_remediation = False
564        if has_failure:
565            requires_remediation = True
566        if reconciliation:
567            if reconciliation.unresolved_blockers > 0 or reconciliation.unresolved_highs > 0:
568                requires_remediation = True
569            elif reconciliation.confirmed or reconciliation.likely:
570                requires_remediation = True
571
572        overall_status = "review_failure" if has_failure else ("has_findings" if all_findings else "clean")
573
574        return ReviewCycleResult(
575            cycle_index=cycle_index,
576            reviewer_results=reviewer_results,
577            all_findings=all_findings,
578            reconciliation=reconciliation,
579            status=overall_status,
580            requires_remediation=requires_remediation,
581        )

Executes each specified reviewer independently against the actual implementation diff. Preserves already-completed reviewer artifacts from previous interrupted runs.

provider_pool is optional (#59.2 Phase 4): when supplied, a reviewer whose primary assignment fails, times out, or produces invalid output gets one bounded fallback attempt against an independent candidate via invoke_reviewer_with_failover, mirroring implementation failover. Omitting it (the default, and the only behavior any caller exercised before #59.2) preserves the prior single-attempt-per-role behavior exactly.

def parse_and_validate_findings( raw_output: str, reviewer_role: str) -> Tuple[List[ReviewFinding], Optional[str], bool]: 
131def parse_and_validate_findings(
132    raw_output: str,
133    reviewer_role: str,
134) -> Tuple[List[ReviewFinding], Optional[str], bool]:
135    """
136    Parses YAML/JSON findings from raw reviewer output.
137    Returns (findings, error_message, is_valid_output).
138    If output is malformed, returns a synthetic finding signaling REVIEWER_FAILURE.
139
140    `is_valid_output` is False whenever zero findings resulted from output that
141    was empty, blank, or otherwise not a deliberate "no findings" signal -- such
142    output must never be indistinguishable from a reviewer that actually ran and
143    reported a clean result (REVIEW_COMPLETED_WITH_NO_FINDINGS, is_valid_output=True).
144    """
145    if not raw_output or not raw_output.strip():
146        # Empty output is never evidence of a completed clean review.
147        return [], None, False
148
149    clean_text = raw_output.strip()
150
151    # Extract yaml / json code block if wrapped in markdown
152    code_block_match = re.search(r"```(?:yaml|json)?\s*\n([\s\S]*?)\n```", clean_text)
153    if code_block_match:
154        payload_text = code_block_match.group(1).strip()
155    else:
156        payload_text = clean_text
157
158    try:
159        parsed = yaml.safe_load(payload_text)
160    except Exception as exc:
161        err_msg = f"Malformed reviewer output YAML: {exc}"
162        failure_finding = ReviewFinding(
163            id=f"ERR-{reviewer_role[:4].upper()}-001",
164            reviewer_role=reviewer_role,
165            title=f"Malformed reviewer output from {reviewer_role}",
166            severity="high",
167            category="other",
168            description=f"Reviewer output failed schema validation: {err_msg}",
169            status="open",
170            claim="Reviewer produced unparseable output format",
171            evidence=raw_output[:500],
172        )
173        return [failure_finding], err_msg, False
174
175    if parsed is None:
176        # Output existed but carried no structured content (e.g. an empty
177        # code block) -- ambiguous, not a deliberate clean signal.
178        return [], None, False
179
180    # Normalization of parsed content
181    findings_list: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
182    if isinstance(parsed, dict):
183        if "findings" in parsed:
184            raw_f = parsed.get("findings")
185            if isinstance(raw_f, list):
186                findings_list = raw_f
187            elif raw_f is None:
188                findings_list = []
189            else:
190                err_msg = f"'findings' field in output must be a list, got {type(raw_f)}"
191                return [_make_err_finding(reviewer_role, err_msg, raw_output)], err_msg, False
192        else:
193            # Maybe single finding object
194            if "title" in parsed or "severity" in parsed:
195                findings_list = [parsed]
196            elif not parsed:
197                # Empty dict -- ambiguous, not a deliberate clean signal.
198                return [], None, False
199            else:
200                err_msg = "Reviewer dictionary output missing 'findings' list"
201                return [_make_err_finding(reviewer_role, err_msg, raw_output)], err_msg, False
202    elif isinstance(parsed, list):
203        findings_list = parsed
204    elif isinstance(parsed, str) and any(w in parsed.lower() for w in ["no defects", "zero findings", "looks good", "clean", "passed", "no issues"]):
205        # An explicit prose "clean" signal is a deliberate, valid result.
206        return [], None, True
207    else:
208        err_msg = f"Unexpected reviewer output type: {type(parsed)}"
209        return [_make_err_finding(reviewer_role, err_msg, raw_output)], err_msg, False
210
211    validated_findings: List[ReviewFinding] = []
212    for idx, item in enumerate(findings_list, 1):
213        if not isinstance(item, dict):
214            err_msg = f"Finding at index {idx} is not a valid dictionary"
215            return [_make_err_finding(reviewer_role, err_msg, raw_output)], err_msg, False
216
217        f_id = str(item.get("id") or f"F{idx:03d}")
218        title = str(item.get("title") or f"Issue found by {reviewer_role}")
219        severity = str(item.get("severity") or "medium").lower().strip()
220        if severity not in VALID_SEVERITIES:
221            severity = "medium"
222
223        category = str(item.get("category") or "correctness").lower().strip()
224        description = str(item.get("description") or item.get("claim") or title)
225        location = item.get("location")
226        claim = item.get("claim")
227        evidence = item.get("evidence")
228        suggested_fix = item.get("suggested_fix")
229        component = item.get("component")
230
231        finding = ReviewFinding(
232            id=f_id,
233            reviewer_role=reviewer_role,
234            title=title,
235            severity=severity,
236            category=category,
237            description=description,
238            component=component,
239            claim=claim,
240            location=location,
241            evidence=evidence,
242            suggested_fix=suggested_fix,
243            status="open",
244        )
245        validated_findings.append(finding)
246
247    # Reaching here means the output was a structurally valid findings
248    # container (an explicit list, a `findings:` key, or `findings: null`),
249    # even when validated_findings ends up empty -- a deliberate clean signal.
250    return validated_findings, None, True

Parses YAML/JSON findings from raw reviewer output. Returns (findings, error_message, is_valid_output). If output is malformed, returns a synthetic finding signaling REVIEWER_FAILURE.

is_valid_output is False whenever zero findings resulted from output that was empty, blank, or otherwise not a deliberate "no findings" signal -- such output must never be indistinguishable from a reviewer that actually ran and reported a clean result (REVIEW_COMPLETED_WITH_NO_FINDINGS, is_valid_output=True).

38@dataclass
39class ReviewFinding(DataClassSerializationMixin):
40    """Represents a single finding discovered during review."""
41

51    location: Optional[str] = None
52    evidence: Optional[str] = None
53    suggested_fix: Optional[str] = None
54    related_finding_ids: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)

59    def __post_init__(self):
60        self.validate()
61
62    def validate(self) -> None:
63        if not self.id or not isinstance(self.id, str):
64            raise ReconciliationValidationError("Finding id must be a non-empty string.")
65        if self.severity not in VALID_SEVERITIES:
66            raise ReconciliationValidationError(
67                f"Finding severity '{self.severity}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_SEVERITIES)}"
68            )
69        if self.status not in VALID_FINDING_STATUSES:
70            raise ReconciliationValidationError(
71                f"Finding status '{self.status}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_FINDING_STATUSES)}"
72            )
73        if self.redundancy_status not in VALID_REDUNDANCY_STATUSES:
74            raise ReconciliationValidationError(
75                f"redundancy_status '{self.redundancy_status}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_REDUNDANCY_STATUSES)}"
76            )
77
78        # Rule: Any dismissed blocker or high finding must have a resolution reason
79        if self.status in ("false_positive", "out_of_scope") and self.severity in ("blocker", "high"):
80            if not self.resolution_reason or not self.resolution_reason.strip():
81                raise ReconciliationValidationError(
82                    f"Finding '{self.id}' with severity '{self.severity}' cannot be marked '{self.status}' "
83                    "without an explicit non-empty resolution_reason."
84                )
85

88        d = dict(data)
89        d.pop("schema", None)
90        return cls(schema=REVIEW_FINDING_SCHEMA_VERSION, **d)

141            f"- **Requires human judgment:** {len(self.requires_human_judgment)}",

143            f"- **Out of scope (dismissed with reason):** {len(self.out_of_scope)}",
144            f"- **Duplicates detected:** {self.duplicate_count}",
145            f"- **Overlapping findings:** {self.overlapping_count}",
146            f"- **Unresolved Blockers / Highs:** {self.unresolved_blockers + self.unresolved_highs}",
147            "",

162                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role}){redundancy_tag}")
163                if f.location:

165                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
166                if f.suggested_fix:
167                    lines.append(f"  - Suggested fix: {f.suggested_fix}")
168            lines.append("")
169
170        if self.likely:
171            lines.append("## Likely Findings (Single Reviewer High Confidence)")
172            for f in self.likely:
173                redundancy_tag = f" `[{f.redundancy_status}]`" if f.redundancy_status != "independent" else ""
174                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role}){redundancy_tag}")
175                if f.location:
176                    lines.append(f"  - Location: `{f.location}`")
177                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
178                if f.suggested_fix:
179                    lines.append(f"  - Suggested fix: {f.suggested_fix}")
180            lines.append("")
181
182        if self.disputed:
183            lines.append("## Disputed Findings (Requires Resolution)")
184            for f in self.disputed:
185                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
186                lines.append(f"  - Description: {f.description}")
187                if f.resolution_reason:
188                    lines.append(f"  - Dispute notes: {f.resolution_reason}")
189            lines.append("")
190
191        if self.requires_human_judgment:
192            lines.append("## Requires Human Judgment")
193            for f in self.requires_human_judgment:
194                lines.append(f"- **[{f.severity.upper()}] {f.id}**: {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
195                lines.append(f"  - Reason for human review: {f.resolution_reason or f.description}")
196            lines.append("")

198        return "\n".join(lines)

class ReviewReconciler: 
201class ReviewReconciler:
202    """Performs deterministic reconciliation of multi-agent review findings."""
203
204    @staticmethod
205    def reconcile(findings: List[ReviewFinding]) -> ReconciliationResult:
206        """
207        Reconciles a collection of review findings into classified categories.
208        Ensures all validations pass and preserves every disagreement.
209        """
210        # Validate all findings first
211        for f in findings:
212            f.validate()
213
214        confirmed: List[ReviewFinding] = []
215        likely: List[ReviewFinding] = []
216        disputed: List[ReviewFinding] = []
217        false_positives: List[ReviewFinding] = []
218        out_of_scope: List[ReviewFinding] = []
219        requires_human: List[ReviewFinding] = []
220
221        unresolved_blockers = 0
222        unresolved_highs = 0
223        duplicate_count = 0
224        overlapping_count = 0
225        findings_by_role: Dict[str, int] = {}
226        unique_findings_by_role: Dict[str, int] = {}
227
228        # Index findings by location and component
229        location_map: Dict[str, List[ReviewFinding]] = {}
230        for f in findings:
231            findings_by_role[f.reviewer_role] = findings_by_role.get(f.reviewer_role, 0) + 1
232            if f.location:
233                loc_key = f.location.strip().lower()
234                location_map.setdefault(loc_key, []).append(f)
235
236        # Detect cross-reviewer duplicates and overlaps
237        processed_pairs = set()
238        for f in findings:
239            if f.location:
240                loc_key = f.location.strip().lower()
241                co_located = location_map.get(loc_key, [])
242                distinct_reviewers = {other.reviewer_role for other in co_located if other.id != f.id}
243
244                if distinct_reviewers:
245                    # Match found across different reviewer roles
246                    other_findings = [other for other in co_located if other.id != f.id]
247                    for other in other_findings:
248                        pair = tuple(sorted([f.id, other.id]))
249                        if pair not in processed_pairs:
250                            processed_pairs.add(pair)
251                            if other.id not in f.related_finding_ids:
252                                f.related_finding_ids.append(other.id)
253                            if f.id not in other.related_finding_ids:
254                                other.related_finding_ids.append(f.id)
255
256                    # Determine redundancy classification
257                    if f.redundancy_status == "independent":
258                        # If first finding for this location, mark overlapping; if subsequent, duplicate
259                        first_for_loc = co_located[0].id == f.id
260                        if first_for_loc:
261                            f.redundancy_status = "overlapping"
262                            overlapping_count += 1
263                        else:
264                            f.redundancy_status = "duplicate"
265                            duplicate_count += 1
266                else:
267                    if f.redundancy_status == "duplicate":
268                        duplicate_count += 1
269                    elif f.redundancy_status == "overlapping":
270                        overlapping_count += 1
271            else:
272                if f.redundancy_status == "duplicate":
273                    duplicate_count += 1
274                elif f.redundancy_status == "overlapping":
275                    overlapping_count += 1
276
277            if f.redundancy_status == "independent":
278                unique_findings_by_role[f.reviewer_role] = unique_findings_by_role.get(f.reviewer_role, 0) + 1
279
280        for f in findings:
281            # Check if status was already set or should be deduced
282            if f.status == "open":
283                # Auto-classification logic
284                loc_matches = location_map.get(f.location.strip().lower(), []) if f.location else []
285                reviewers_at_loc = {m.reviewer_role for m in loc_matches}
286
287                if len(reviewers_at_loc) > 1:
288                    # Multiple distinct reviewers flagged this location
289                    f.status = "confirmed"
290                elif f.severity in ("blocker", "high") and f.category == "security":
291                    f.status = "requires_human_judgment"
292                    f.resolution_reason = "Security-critical finding automatically routed for human verification."
293                elif f.severity in ("blocker", "high"):
294                    f.status = "likely"
295                else:
296                    f.status = "likely"
297
298            # Sort into buckets
299            if f.status == "confirmed":
300                confirmed.append(f)
301            elif f.status == "likely":
302                likely.append(f)
303            elif f.status == "disputed":
304                disputed.append(f)
305            elif f.status == "false_positive":
306                false_positives.append(f)
307            elif f.status == "out_of_scope":
308                out_of_scope.append(f)
309            elif f.status == "requires_human_judgment":
310                requires_human.append(f)
311
312            # Count unresolved severe items
313            if f.status in ("confirmed", "likely", "disputed", "requires_human_judgment"):
314                if f.severity == "blocker":
315                    unresolved_blockers += 1
316                elif f.severity == "high":
317                    unresolved_highs += 1
318
319        return ReconciliationResult(
320            findings=findings,
321            confirmed=confirmed,
322            likely=likely,
323            disputed=disputed,
324            false_positives=false_positives,
325            out_of_scope=out_of_scope,
326            requires_human_judgment=requires_human,
327            unresolved_blockers=unresolved_blockers,
328            unresolved_highs=unresolved_highs,
329            duplicate_count=duplicate_count,
330            overlapping_count=overlapping_count,
331            unique_findings_by_role=unique_findings_by_role,
332            findings_by_role=findings_by_role,
333        )

167            required=required,
168            interpreter=interpreter,
169            metadata=metadata or {},
170        )
171        self.steps.append(step)
172
173    def execute_step(self, step: VerificationStep, cwd: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
174        """
175        Executes a single step deterministically using subprocess without shell=True.
176        Enforces provider integrity for repository hygiene gates.
177        Transitions: claimed -> tested -> observed -> (verified | failed).
178        """
179        step.status = "tested"
180        cmd_args: List[str]
181        if isinstance(step.command, str):
182            cmd_args = shlex.split(step.command)
183        else:
184            cmd_args = list(step.command)
185
186        start_time = time.time()
187        env = os.environ.copy()
188        target_root = Path(cwd).resolve() if cwd else Path.cwd()
189
190        # Hygiene provider integrity check
191        if step.category == "repository_hygiene" or (cmd_args and "slopslint" in cmd_args[0]):
192            ok, msg, prov_meta = HygienePolicyClassifier.verify_provider_integrity(
193                executable_name="slopslint",
194                pinned_version=PINNED_SLOPSLINT_VERSION,
195            )
196            step.metadata["hygiene_provider"] = prov_meta
197            if not ok:
198                step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
199                step.exit_code = 127 if prov_meta.get("status") == "missing" else 1
200                step.stderr = f"Hygiene provider integrity failure: {msg}"
201                step.status = "failed"
202                return
203            # Use resolved absolute binary path to avoid PATH hijacking
204            if cmd_args and cmd_args[0] == "slopslint" and prov_meta.get("path"):
205                cmd_args[0] = prov_meta["path"]
206
207        # Resolve Python interpreter deterministically for python-based commands
208        try:
209            resolved_py = resolve_python_interpreter(target_root)
210            step.interpreter = resolved_py
211            py_bin_dir = str(Path(resolved_py).parent)
212            env["PATH"] = f"{py_bin_dir}:{env.get('PATH', '')}"
213            if "venv" in py_bin_dir or ".venv" in py_bin_dir:
214                env["VIRTUAL_ENV"] = str(Path(resolved_py).parent.parent)
215        except Exception:
216            step.interpreter = sys.executable
217
218        # If command starts with python/pytest/flake8/bandit and we resolved a specific venv python
219        if cmd_args and cmd_args[0] in ("python", "python3") and step.interpreter:
220            cmd_args[0] = step.interpreter
221        elif cmd_args and cmd_args[0] in ("pytest", "flake8", "bandit", "mypy", "black", "pdoc") and step.interpreter:
222            candidate_bin = Path(step.interpreter).parent / cmd_args[0]
223            if candidate_bin.is_file() and os.access(candidate_bin, os.X_OK):
224                cmd_args[0] = str(candidate_bin)
225
226        try:
227            res = subprocess.run(
228                cmd_args,
229                cwd=cwd,
230                capture_output=True,
231                text=True,
232                env=env,
233                timeout=300,
234            )
235            step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
236            step.exit_code = res.returncode
237            step.stdout = res.stdout
238            step.stderr = res.stderr
239            step.status = "observed"
240
241            if res.returncode == 0:
242                step.status = "verified"
243            else:
244                step.status = "failed"
245
246        except Exception as e:
247            step.duration_seconds = round(time.time() - start_time, 3)
248            step.exit_code = -1
249            step.stderr = str(e)
250            step.status = "failed"
251
252    def execute_all(self, cwd: Optional[str] = None, stop_on_failure: bool = False) -> str:
253        """
254        Executes all steps in order and computes the overall status.
255        """
256        any_failed = False
257        all_passed = True
258
259        for step in self.steps:
260            self.execute_step(step, cwd=cwd)
261            if step.status == "failed":
262                any_failed = True
263                if step.required:
264                    all_passed = False
265                if stop_on_failure:
266                    break
267            elif step.status != "verified":
268                all_passed = False
269
270        if any_failed:
271            self.overall_status = "failed"
272        elif all_passed:
273            self.overall_status = "passed"
274        else:
275            self.overall_status = "partial"
276
277        return self.overall_status
278
279    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
280        return {
281            "schema": self.schema,
282            "task_id": self.task_id,
283            "overall_status": self.overall_status,
284            "steps": [s.to_dict() for s in self.steps],
285        }
286
287    @classmethod
288    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "VerificationPlan":
289        steps_data = data.get("steps", [])
290        steps = [VerificationStep.from_dict(item) for item in steps_data]
291        return cls(
292            task_id=data.get("task_id", ""),
293            steps=steps,
294            overall_status=data.get("overall_status", "unverified"),
295        )
