class GovernedTaskOrchestrator: 
 143class GovernedTaskOrchestrator:
 144    """
 145    Drives the end-to-end governed engineering lifecycle, maintaining
 146    strict control over state transitions, adversarial reviews,
 147    remediation loops, verification gates, and human authority boundaries.
 148    """
 149
 150    def __init__(
 151        self,
 152        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
 153        control_plane_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
 154        config: Optional[OrchestrationConfig] = None,
 155    ):
 156        self.target_repo = Path(target_repo).resolve()
 157        self.control_plane_root = (
 158            Path(control_plane_root).resolve()
 159            if control_plane_root
 160            else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
 161        )
 162        self.config = config or OrchestrationConfig()
 163        ledger_path = str(self.control_plane_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "evidence_ledger.jsonl")
 164        self.ledger = EvidenceLedger(ledger_path)
 165
 166    def _record_event(
 167        self,
 168        task_id: str,
 169        agent_id: str,
 170        action: str,
 171        command: Optional[str] = None,
 172        result: Optional[str] = None,
 173        artifact: Optional[str] = None,
 174        spec: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
 175        findings_summary: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None,
 176        verification_summary: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None,
 177        metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
 178    ) -> None:
 179        """Records an immutable event in the append-only evidence ledger."""
 180        if not self.config.record_evidence:
 181            return
 182
 183        meta = metadata or {}
 184        entry = EvidenceEntry(
 185            task_id=task_id,
 186            agent_id=agent_id,
 187            action=action,
 188            command=command,
 189            result=result,
 190            artifact=artifact,
 191            task_class=spec.task_class if spec else None,
 192            risk_level=spec.risk_level if spec else None,
 193            reasoning_tier=spec.recommended_reasoning_tier if spec else None,
 194            actual_agent=agent_id,
 195            repository=self.target_repo.name,
 196            findings_summary=findings_summary,
 197            verification_summary=verification_summary,
 198            metadata=meta,
 199        )
 200        try:
 201            self.ledger.append_entry(entry)
 202        except Exception:
 203            pass
 204
 205    def prepare_task_plan(
 206        self,
 207        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 208        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 209    ) -> Tuple[ProjectContext, RoutingDecision, VerificationPlan, Path, Optional[Any]]:
 210        """Prepares task run directory, project discovery, routing, verification plan, and review briefs."""
 211        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
 212        run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 213        (run_dir / "reviews").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 214        (run_dir / "remediation").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 215
 216        ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(self.target_repo)
 217        (run_dir / "project_context.json").write_text(ctx.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 218
 219        router = TaskRouter()
 220        routing = router.route(task_spec)
 221        (run_dir / "route.json").write_text(json.dumps(asdict(routing), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
 222
 223        verif_plan = ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(ctx, task_id=task_spec.task_id)
 224        (run_dir / "verification_plan.json").write_text(verif_plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 225
 226        task_spec.recommended_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
 227        task_spec.actual_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
 228        task_spec.is_override = routing.is_override
 229        task_spec.override_reason = routing.rationale if routing.is_override else None
 230        if task_spec.current_state == "discovered":
 231            task_spec.transition_to("planned", "Task routed and verification plan generated")
 232        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 233        skill_ctx = build_skill_context(task_spec)
 234        for role_id in routing.recommended_reviewers:
 235            role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
 236            if role:
 237                (run_dir / "reviews" / f"{role_id}.md").write_text(
 238                    role.render_brief(task=task_spec, diff_content="", context=skill_ctx), encoding="utf-8"
 239                )
 240        (run_dir / "findings_template.yaml").write_text("# Review Findings Template\nfindings: []\n", encoding="utf-8")
 241
 242        hf_res = None
 243        if self.config.enable_howlframe_audit:
 244            try:
 245                hf_res = HowlFrameAuditRunner.run_audit(
 246                    context=ctx,
 247                    record_evidence=self.config.record_evidence,
 248                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 249                    ledger=self.ledger,
 250                    dogfood_mode="shadow",
 251                )
 252                (run_dir / "howlframe_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(hf_res.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
 253            except Exception:
 254                pass
 255
 256        # Check pre-execution human authority boundary and bind HowlChangeOps decision if applicable
 257        pre_b = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
 258            task=task_spec,
 259            planned_actions=planned_actions,
 260            target_repo=self.target_repo,
 261        )
 262        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_b, run_dir)
 263        if pre_b.requires_human_approval and pre_b.decision_packet:
 264            (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(pre_b.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
 265
 266        return ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res
 267
 268    def _bind_decision_packet(self, boundary_res: Any, run_dir: Path) -> None:
 269        """Binds bounded executor decision ID to human decision packet if required."""
 270        if not boundary_res.requires_human_approval or not boundary_res.decision_packet:
 271            return
 272        if not boundary_res.decision_packet.proposed_actions:
 273            return
 274        act_dict = boundary_res.decision_packet.proposed_actions[0]
 275        action_obj = ProposedAction.from_dict(act_dict)
 276        from src.control_plane.executor import ExecutorRegistry
 277        executor = ExecutorRegistry.get_executor_for_action(action_obj.action_type)
 278        if executor and executor.is_available():
 279            verdict, dec_id, _ = executor.evaluate(action_obj, self.target_repo, run_dir)
 280            if dec_id:
 281                boundary_res.decision_packet.changeops_decision_id = dec_id
 282                boundary_res.decision_packet.executor_id = executor.name
 283
 284    def run(
 285        self,
 286        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 287        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 288    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
 289        """
 290        Executes the complete governed control-plane loop for the task under
 291        mutual-exclusion locks and durable checkpoint guarantees.
 292        """
 293        start_time = time.time()
 294
 295        # Acquire Locks if enabled
 296        repo_lock = (
 297            RepoLock(self.target_repo, task_spec.task_id, command=f"ai work {task_spec.task_id} --execute")
 298            if self.config.acquire_locks
 299            else None
 300        )
 301        task_lock = (
 302            TaskLock(self.target_repo, task_spec.task_id, operation="orchestrate")
 303            if self.config.acquire_locks
 304            else None
 305        )
 306
 307        if repo_lock:
 308            repo_lock.acquire()
 309        if task_lock:
 310            task_lock.acquire()
 311
 312        try:
 313            return self._run_governed_loop(task_spec, planned_actions, start_time)
 314        except Exception as exc:
 315            run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
 316            if run_dir.is_dir():
 317                try:
 318                    CheckpointManager.record_interrupted(
 319                        run_dir, stage=task_spec.current_state, reason=str(exc)
 320                    )
 321                except Exception:
 322                    pass
 323            raise
 324        finally:
 325            if task_lock:
 326                task_lock.release()
 327            if repo_lock:
 328                repo_lock.release()
 329
 330    def _run_governed_loop(
 331        self,
 332        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 333        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 334        start_time: Optional[float] = None,
 335    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
 336        start_time = start_time or time.time()
 337        ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res = self.prepare_task_plan(task_spec, planned_actions)
 338        reviews_dir = run_dir / "reviews"
 339        remediation_base_dir = run_dir / "remediation"
 340        hf_audit_status = hf_res.status if hf_res else None
 341        hf_audit_match = (hf_res.status == "MATCH") if hf_res else True
 342
 343        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
 344            run_dir,
 345            task_spec.task_id,
 346            "planned",
 347            repo_path=self.target_repo,
 348            input_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "route.json"), str(run_dir / "verification_plan.json")],
 349        )
 350
 351        self._record_event(
 352            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 353            agent_id="control_plane",
 354            action="task_created",
 355            spec=task_spec,
 356            metadata={"repo_path": str(self.target_repo), "project_types": ctx.project_types},
 357        )
 358        self._record_event(
 359            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 360            agent_id="control_plane",
 361            action="project_discovered",
 362            spec=task_spec,
 363            metadata={"hygiene_status": ctx.hygiene_status, "has_agents_md": ctx.has_agents_md},
 364        )
 365        self._record_event(
 366            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 367            agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
 368            action="route_selected",
 369            spec=task_spec,
 370            metadata={
 371                "selected_agent": routing.selected_agent_id,
 372                "reviewers": routing.recommended_reviewers,
 373                "is_override": routing.is_override,
 374            },
 375        )
 376        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(run_dir, "planned")
 377
 378        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 379        # Stage 2.5: Pre-Execution Human Authority Gating
 380        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 381        pre_boundary = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
 382            task=task_spec,
 383            planned_actions=planned_actions,
 384            target_repo=self.target_repo,
 385        )
 386        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_boundary, run_dir)
 387
 388        if pre_boundary.requires_human_approval:
 389
 390            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
 391                run_dir,
 392                task_spec.task_id,
 393                "awaiting_human",
 394                repo_path=self.target_repo,
 395                metadata={"boundary_triggers": pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries},
 396            )
 397            task_spec.transition_to(
 398                "awaiting_human",
 399                f"Pre-execution human authority boundary triggered: {pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries}",
 400            )
 401            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 402
 403            if pre_boundary.decision_packet:
 404                (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(
 405                    pre_boundary.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8"
 406                )
 407
 408            self._record_human_boundary_events(
 409                task_spec, run_dir, boundaries=pre_boundary.triggered_boundaries, reason="Pre-execution boundary triggered"
 410            )
 411
 412            stage_kwargs = dict(
 413                start_time=start_time,
 414                run_dir=run_dir,
 415                routing=routing,
 416                initial_delta=None,
 417                current_delta=None,
 418                review_cycles=[],
 419                reconciliation=None,
 420                verif_plan=verif_plan,
 421                boundary_res=pre_boundary,
 422                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
 423                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
 424                remediation_count=0,
 425            )
 426            return self._make_result(task_spec, "awaiting_human", 2, **stage_kwargs)
 427
 428        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 429        # Stage 3: Baseline Capture / Baseline Recovery
 430        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 431        baseline_file = run_dir / "baseline.json"
 432        if baseline_file.is_file():
 433            try:
 434                baseline = GitBaseline.from_dict(safe_load_json(baseline_file))
 435            except Exception:
 436                baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
 437                (run_dir / "baseline.json").write_text(baseline.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 438        else:
 439            baseline = capture_baseline(self.target_repo)
 440            (run_dir / "baseline.json").write_text(baseline.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 441
 442        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 443        # Stage 4: Implementation (implementing) / Reconcile on Recovery
 444        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 445        impl_backend = self.config.custom_backend or AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend(routing.selected_agent_id)
 446        if not impl_backend.is_available() and not self.config.custom_backend:
 447            err_msg = f"Selected agent '{routing.selected_agent_id}' is not installed or available on PATH."
 448            return self._fail_task(
 449                task_spec,
 450                run_dir,
 451                err_msg,
 452                start_time,
 453                exit_code=1,
 454                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
 455                routing=routing,
 456                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
 457                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
 458            )
 459
 460        has_existing_delta, rec_delta, rec_msg = CrashRecoveryEngine.reconcile_interrupted_implementation(
 461            self.target_repo, run_dir, task_spec
 462        )
 463
 464        impl_dir = run_dir / "implementation"
 465        impl_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 466
 467        # Stays None on the crash-recovery path, where an interrupted
 468        # implementation's delta is reconciled rather than re-run: there is no
 469        # provider execution in *this* process to report (#59.1 Phase 1).
 470        impl_res: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None
 471
 472        if has_existing_delta and rec_delta:
 473            current_delta = rec_delta
 474            initial_delta = rec_delta
 475            self._record_event(
 476                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 477                agent_id="control_plane",
 478                action="implementation_recovered",
 479                spec=task_spec,
 480                metadata={"files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added)},
 481            )
 482        else:
 483            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
 484                run_dir,
 485                task_spec.task_id,
 486                "implementing",
 487                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
 488                repo_path=self.target_repo,
 489            )
 490
 491            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
 492                self.config.failure_injection_hook("implementing", run_dir, task_spec)
 493
 494            if task_spec.current_state != "implementing":
 495                task_spec.transition_to("implementing", f"Launching implementation agent: {routing.selected_agent_id}")
 496                task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 497
 498            self._record_event(
 499                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 500                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
 501                action="implementation_started",
 502                spec=task_spec,
 503            )
 504
 505            impl_prompt = self._build_implementation_prompt(task_spec, ctx)
 506            impl_res = impl_backend.execute(
 507                task=task_spec,
 508                cwd=self.target_repo,
 509                role="implementation",
 510                prompt_override=impl_prompt,
 511                timeout_seconds=self.config.timeout_seconds,
 512            )
 513
 514            (impl_dir / "result.json").write_text(impl_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 515
 516            if not impl_res.success:
 517                err_msg = (
 518                    impl_res.stderr.strip()
 519                    if impl_res.stderr and impl_res.stderr.strip()
 520                    else (impl_res.error_message or f"Implementation failed with exit code {impl_res.exit_code}")
 521                )
 522                self._record_event(
 523                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 524                    agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
 525                    action="implementation_completed",
 526                    result="failure",
 527                    spec=task_spec,
 528                    metadata={"exit_code": impl_res.exit_code, "error": err_msg},
 529                )
 530                return self._fail_task(
 531                    task_spec,
 532                    run_dir,
 533                    err_msg,
 534                    start_time,
 535                    exit_code=impl_res.exit_code if impl_res.exit_code != 0 else 1,
 536                    agent_id="control_plane",
 537                    routing=routing,
 538                    hf_status=hf_audit_status,
 539                    hf_match=hf_audit_match,
 540                    # Propagate the provider's own execution evidence verbatim
 541                    # (#59.1 Phase 1). The caller re-classifies this through
 542                    # detect_exhaustion(); ENGINEERING_FAILURE is only the
 543                    # default when no provider-availability signal is found.
 544                    provider_execution=impl_res,
 545                    failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_ENGINEERING,
 546                )
 547
 548            current_delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
 549            (impl_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(current_delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 550            (run_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(current_delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 551
 552            self._record_event(
 553                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 554                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
 555                action="implementation_completed",
 556                result="success",
 557                spec=task_spec,
 558                metadata={"files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added)},
 559            )
 560            self._record_event(
 561                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 562                agent_id="control_plane",
 563                action="repository_delta_captured",
 564                spec=task_spec,
 565                metadata={
 566                    "files_added": current_delta.files_added,
 567                    "files_modified": current_delta.files_modified,
 568                    "files_deleted": current_delta.files_deleted,
 569                    "insertions": current_delta.insertions,
 570                    "deletions": current_delta.deletions,
 571                },
 572            )
 573            initial_delta = current_delta
 574            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(run_dir, "implementing", output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "diff.patch")])
 575
 576            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
 577                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_implementation", run_dir, task_spec)
 578
 579        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 580        # Stage 5: Independent Adversarial Reviews & Remediation Loop
 581        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 582        if task_spec.current_state != "reviewing":
 583            task_spec.transition_to("reviewing", "Initiating independent reviewer analysis on actual implementation diff")
 584            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 585
 586        review_cycles: List[ReviewCycleResult] = []
 587        latest_reconciliation: Optional[ReconciliationResult] = None
 588        remediation_count = 0
 589        current_reviewers = list(routing.recommended_reviewers)
 590
 591        while True:
 592            cycle_idx = len(review_cycles) + 1
 593            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
 594                run_dir,
 595                task_spec.task_id,
 596                "reviewing",
 597                repo_path=self.target_repo,
 598                metadata={"cycle": cycle_idx, "reviewers": current_reviewers},
 599            )
 600
 601            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
 602                self.config.failure_injection_hook("reviewing", run_dir, task_spec)
 603
 604            self._record_event(
 605                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 606                agent_id="control_plane",
 607                action="review_started",
 608                spec=task_spec,
 609                metadata={"cycle": cycle_idx, "reviewers": current_reviewers},
 610            )
 611
 612            cycle_res = ReviewRunner.execute_review_cycle(
 613                task=task_spec,
 614                diff_content=current_delta.diff_content,
 615                reviewer_roles=current_reviewers,
 616                cwd=self.target_repo,
 617                backend=self.config.custom_backend,
 618                cycle_index=cycle_idx,
 619                reviewer_agent_mapping=self.config.reviewer_agent_mapping,
 620                custom_reviewer_fn=self.config.custom_reviewer_fn,
 621                run_dir=run_dir,
 622            )
 623            review_cycles.append(cycle_res)
 624            latest_reconciliation = cycle_res.reconciliation
 625
 626            # Save review cycle artifacts
 627            cycle_dir = reviews_dir if cycle_idx == 1 else (remediation_base_dir / f"cycle-{remediation_count:02d}" / "re_review")
 628            cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 629            for role_id, single_rev in cycle_res.reviewer_results.items():
 630                (cycle_dir / f"{role_id}.md").write_text(single_rev.raw_output, encoding="utf-8")
 631                (cycle_dir / f"{role_id}_findings.yaml").write_text(
 632                    yaml.dump([f.to_dict() for f in single_rev.findings], sort_keys=False),
 633                    encoding="utf-8",
 634                )
 635
 636            # Persist findings and reconciliation
 637            findings_data = {"findings": [f.to_dict() for f in cycle_res.all_findings]}
 638            (run_dir / "findings.yaml").write_text(yaml.dump(findings_data, sort_keys=False), encoding="utf-8")
 639            if cycle_res.reconciliation:
 640                (run_dir / "reconciliation.json").write_text(json.dumps(cycle_res.reconciliation.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
 641                (run_dir / "reconciliation_report.md").write_text(cycle_res.reconciliation.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
 642
 643            findings_summary = {
 644                "total": len(cycle_res.all_findings),
 645                "blocker": cycle_res.reconciliation.unresolved_blockers if cycle_res.reconciliation else 0,
 646                "high": cycle_res.reconciliation.unresolved_highs if cycle_res.reconciliation else 0,
 647            }
 648            self._record_event(
 649                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 650                agent_id="control_plane",
 651                action="review_completed",
 652                spec=task_spec,
 653                findings_summary=findings_summary,
 654                metadata={"status": cycle_res.status, "cycle": cycle_idx},
 655            )
 656            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
 657                run_dir,
 658                "reviewing",
 659                output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "reconciliation.json")],
 660                result_summary=findings_summary,
 661            )
 662
 663            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
 664                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_review", run_dir, task_spec)
 665
 666            # Check if any findings require remediation
 667            if not cycle_res.requires_remediation:
 668                break
 669
 670            # If remediation required, check cycle bounds
 671            if remediation_count >= self.config.max_remediation_cycles:
 672                err_msg = (
 673                    f"Remediation limit reached ({self.config.max_remediation_cycles} cycles) with "
 674                    f"{findings_summary['blocker']} blockers and {findings_summary['high']} high findings remaining."
 675                )
 676                task_spec.transition_to("awaiting_human", f"Max remediation cycles exceeded: {err_msg}")
 677                task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 678
 679                decision_pkt = HumanDecisionPacket(
 680                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 681                    objective=task_spec.objective,
 682                    change_summary=f"Implementation diff ({current_delta.insertions} ins, {current_delta.deletions} del) has unresolved reviewer findings.",
 683                    boundary_triggers=["security_policy_exception"] if findings_summary["high"] > 0 else ["unresolved_findings"],
 684                    evidence=[f.title for f in cycle_res.all_findings if f.severity in ("blocker", "high")],
 685                    risks=["Unresolved reviewer findings may indicate defects or security vulnerabilities."],
 686                    review_findings_summary=findings_summary,
 687                    verification_status="unverified",
 688                    recommended_action="Review finding report in reconciliation_report.md and authorize override or manual remediation.",
 689                )
 690                (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(decision_pkt.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
 691                self._record_human_boundary_events(task_spec, run_dir, reason=err_msg)
 692                return self._make_result(
 693                    task_spec=task_spec,
 694                    final_state="awaiting_human",
 695                    exit_code=2,
 696                    start_time=start_time,
 697                    run_dir=run_dir,
 698                    routing=routing,
 699                    initial_delta=initial_delta,
 700                    current_delta=current_delta,
 701                    review_cycles=review_cycles,
 702                    reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
 703                    verif_plan=verif_plan,
 704                    remediation_count=remediation_count,
 705                    err_msg=err_msg,
 706                    provider_execution=impl_res,
 707                    failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED,
 708                )
 709
 710            remediation_count += 1
 711            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
 712                run_dir,
 713                task_spec.task_id,
 714                "remediating",
 715                repo_path=self.target_repo,
 716                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count},
 717            )
 718
 719            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
 720                self.config.failure_injection_hook("remediating", run_dir, task_spec)
 721
 722            task_spec.transition_to(
 723                "remediating",
 724                f"Remediation cycle {remediation_count}: resolving {len(cycle_res.all_findings)} review findings",
 725            )
 726            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 727
 728            self._record_event(
 729                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 730                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
 731                action="remediation_started",
 732                spec=task_spec,
 733                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count, "findings_count": len(cycle_res.all_findings)},
 734            )
 735
 736            rem_cycle_dir = remediation_base_dir / f"cycle-{remediation_count:02d}"
 737            rem_cycle_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
 738
 739            if self.config.custom_remediation_fn:
 740                self.config.custom_remediation_fn(task_spec, self.target_repo, cycle_res.all_findings)
 741            else:
 742                rem_prompt = self._build_remediation_prompt(task_spec, current_delta.diff_content, cycle_res.all_findings)
 743                rem_res = impl_backend.execute(
 744                    task=task_spec,
 745                    cwd=self.target_repo,
 746                    role="remediation",
 747                    prompt_override=rem_prompt,
 748                    timeout_seconds=self.config.timeout_seconds,
 749                )
 750                (rem_cycle_dir / "result.json").write_text(rem_res.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 751
 752            current_delta = capture_delta(self.target_repo, baseline)
 753            (rem_cycle_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(current_delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 754            (run_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(current_delta.diff_content, encoding="utf-8")
 755
 756            self._record_event(
 757                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 758                agent_id=routing.selected_agent_id,
 759                action="remediation_completed",
 760                spec=task_spec,
 761                metadata={"cycle": remediation_count, "files_modified": len(current_delta.files_modified)},
 762            )
 763            self._record_event(
 764                task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 765                agent_id="control_plane",
 766                action="repository_delta_captured",
 767                spec=task_spec,
 768            )
 769            CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
 770                run_dir,
 771                "remediating",
 772                output_artifacts=[str(rem_cycle_dir / "diff.patch")],
 773            )
 774
 775            if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
 776                self.config.failure_injection_hook("post_remediation", run_dir, task_spec)
 777
 778            current_reviewers = ReviewRunner.determine_re_review_roles(
 779                cycle_res.all_findings,
 780                routing.recommended_reviewers,
 781            )
 782            task_spec.transition_to("reviewing", f"Re-review cycle {remediation_count + 1} for targeted roles: {current_reviewers}")
 783            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 784
 785        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 786        # Stage 6: Deterministic Verification Gate (verifying)
 787        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 788        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
 789            run_dir,
 790            task_spec.task_id,
 791            "verifying",
 792            repo_path=self.target_repo,
 793            input_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "diff.patch")],
 794        )
 795
 796        if self.config.failure_injection_hook:
 797            self.config.failure_injection_hook("verifying", run_dir, task_spec)
 798
 799        task_spec.transition_to("verifying", "Executing deterministic verification plan")
 800        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 801
 802        self._record_event(
 803            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 804            agent_id="control_plane",
 805            action="verification_started",
 806            spec=task_spec,
 807            metadata={"steps_count": len(verif_plan.steps)},
 808        )
 809
 810        verif_status = verif_plan.execute_all(
 811            cwd=str(self.target_repo),
 812            stop_on_failure=self.config.stop_on_verification_failure,
 813        )
 814        (run_dir / "verification_result.json").write_text(verif_plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
 815
 816        verif_summary = {s.name: s.status for s in verif_plan.steps}
 817        self._record_event(
 818            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 819            agent_id="control_plane",
 820            action="verification_completed",
 821            spec=task_spec,
 822            result=verif_status,
 823            verification_summary=verif_summary,
 824        )
 825        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
 826            run_dir,
 827            "verifying",
 828            output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "verification_result.json")],
 829            result_summary=verif_summary,
 830        )
 831
 832        if verif_status != "passed":
 833            failed_steps = [s.name for s in verif_plan.steps if s.status == "failed" and s.required]
 834            err_msg = f"Deterministic verification failed on required steps: {', '.join(failed_steps)}"
 835            return self._fail_task(
 836                task_spec,
 837                run_dir,
 838                err_msg,
 839                start_time,
 840                exit_code=1,
 841                routing=routing,
 842                initial_delta=initial_delta,
 843                current_delta=current_delta,
 844                review_cycles=review_cycles,
 845                reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
 846                verif_plan=verif_plan,
 847                hf_status=hf_audit_status,
 848                hf_match=hf_audit_match,
 849                remediation_count=remediation_count,
 850                provider_execution=impl_res,
 851                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_VERIFICATION,
 852            )
 853
 854        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 855        # Stage 7: Human Authority Boundary Gate (awaiting_human)
 856        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 857        actions_to_check = list(planned_actions or [])
 858        if any(kw in task_spec.objective.lower() for kw in ["deploy", "terraform apply", "kubectl apply", "drop table"]):
 859            actions_to_check.append(task_spec.objective)
 860
 861        boundary_res = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate(
 862            task=task_spec,
 863            planned_actions=actions_to_check,
 864            change_summary=f"Changed {len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added)} files (+{current_delta.insertions}/-{current_delta.deletions})",
 865            reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
 866            verification=verif_plan,
 867        )
 868
 869        stage_kwargs = dict(
 870            start_time=start_time,
 871            run_dir=run_dir,
 872            routing=routing,
 873            initial_delta=initial_delta,
 874            current_delta=current_delta,
 875            review_cycles=review_cycles,
 876            reconciliation=latest_reconciliation,
 877            verif_plan=verif_plan,
 878            boundary_res=boundary_res,
 879            hf_status=hf_audit_status,
 880            hf_match=hf_audit_match,
 881            remediation_count=remediation_count,
 882            provider_execution=impl_res,
 883        )
 884
 885        if boundary_res.requires_human_approval:
 886            CheckpointManager.start_stage(
 887                run_dir,
 888                task_spec.task_id,
 889                "awaiting_human",
 890                repo_path=self.target_repo,
 891                metadata={"boundary_triggers": boundary_res.triggered_boundaries},
 892            )
 893            task_spec.transition_to("awaiting_human", f"Human authority boundary triggered: {boundary_res.triggered_boundaries}")
 894            task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 895
 896            if boundary_res.decision_packet:
 897                (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(boundary_res.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
 898
 899            self._record_human_boundary_events(
 900                task_spec, run_dir, boundaries=boundary_res.triggered_boundaries
 901            )
 902
 903            return self._make_result(
 904                task_spec, "awaiting_human", 2,
 905                failure_class=FAILURE_CLASS_AUTHORITY_BLOCKED, **stage_kwargs,
 906            )
 907
 908        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 909        # Stage 8: Governed Completion (complete)
 910        # --------------------------------------------------------------------
 911        CheckpointManager.start_stage(
 912            run_dir,
 913            task_spec.task_id,
 914            "complete",
 915            repo_path=self.target_repo,
 916        )
 917        task_spec.transition_to("complete", "All reviews, reconciliations, deterministic verifications, and policies passed.")
 918        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
 919
 920        # Generate summary markdown
 921        summary_md = self._render_summary_markdown(
 922            task=task_spec,
 923            routing=routing,
 924            delta=current_delta,
 925            review_cycles=review_cycles,
 926            verif_plan=verif_plan,
 927            remediation_count=remediation_count,
 928            hf_status=hf_audit_status,
 929        )
 930        (run_dir / "summary.md").write_text(summary_md, encoding="utf-8")
 931
 932        self._record_event(
 933            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 934            agent_id="control_plane",
 935            action="task_completed",
 936            spec=task_spec,
 937            metadata={
 938                "remediation_cycles": remediation_count,
 939                "verification_status": verif_status,
 940                "files_changed": len(current_delta.files_modified) + len(current_delta.files_added),
 941            },
 942        )
 943        CheckpointManager.complete_stage(
 944            run_dir,
 945            "complete",
 946            output_artifacts=[str(run_dir / "summary.md")],
 947        )
 948
 949        return self._make_result(task_spec, "complete", 0, **stage_kwargs)
 950
 951    def _record_human_boundary_events(
 952        self,
 953        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 954        run_dir: Path,
 955        boundaries: Optional[List[str]] = None,
 956        reason: Optional[str] = None,
 957    ) -> None:
 958        meta = {"boundaries": boundaries} if boundaries else {"reason": reason}
 959        self._record_event(
 960            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 961            agent_id="control_plane",
 962            action="human_decision_requested",
 963            artifact=str(run_dir / "decision_packet.md"),
 964            spec=task_spec,
 965            metadata=meta,
 966        )
 967        self._record_event(
 968            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 969            agent_id="control_plane",
 970            action="human_boundary_triggered",
 971            spec=task_spec,
 972            metadata=meta,
 973        )

 975    def _make_result(
 976        self,
 977        task_spec: TaskSpec,
 978        final_state: str,
 979        exit_code: int,
 980        start_time: float,
 981        run_dir: Path,
 982        routing: Optional[Any] = None,
 983        initial_delta: Optional[Any] = None,
 984        current_delta: Optional[Any] = None,
 985        review_cycles: Optional[List[Any]] = None,
 986        reconciliation: Optional[Any] = None,
 987        verif_plan: Optional[Any] = None,
 988        boundary_res: Optional[Any] = None,
 989        hf_status: Optional[str] = None,
 990        hf_match: Optional[bool] = None,
 991        remediation_count: int = 0,
 992        err_msg: Optional[str] = None,
 993        provider_execution: Optional[AgentExecutionResult] = None,
 994        failure_class: Optional[str] = None,
 995    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
 996        return OrchestrationResult(
 997            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
 998            task_spec=task_spec,
 999            final_state=final_state,
1000            exit_code=exit_code,
1001            routing_decision=routing,
1002            initial_delta=initial_delta,
1003            final_delta=current_delta,
1004            review_cycles=review_cycles or [],
1005            reconciliation=reconciliation,
1006            verification_plan=verif_plan,
1007            boundary_result=boundary_res,
1008            howlframe_audit_status=hf_status,
1009            howlframe_audit_match=hf_match,
1010            remediation_cycles_count=remediation_count,
1011            duration_seconds=round(time.time() - start_time, 3),
1012            error_message=err_msg,
1013            run_dir=str(run_dir),
1014            provider_execution=provider_execution,
1015            failure_class=failure_class,
1016        )
1017
1018    def _fail_task(
1019        self,
1020        task_spec: TaskSpec,
1021        run_dir: Path,
1022        err_msg: str,
1023        start_time: float,
1024        exit_code: int = 1,
1025        agent_id: str = "control_plane",
1026        **kwargs,
1027    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
1028        task_spec.transition_to("failed", err_msg)
1029        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
1030        self._record_event(
1031            task_id=task_spec.task_id,
1032            agent_id=agent_id,
1033            action="task_failed",
1034            result=err_msg,
1035            spec=task_spec,
1036        )
1037        return self._make_result(
1038            task_spec=task_spec,
1039            final_state="failed",
1040            exit_code=exit_code,
1041            start_time=start_time,
1042            run_dir=run_dir,
1043            err_msg=err_msg,
1044            **kwargs,
1045        )

1047    def _build_implementation_prompt(
1048        self,
1049        task: TaskSpec,
1050        ctx: Optional[ProjectContext] = None,
1051    ) -> str:
1052        """Constructs an implementation prompt with criteria and skill guidance."""
1053        lines = [
1054            f"# Task Implementation Request: `{task.task_id}`",
1055            f"**Objective:** {task.objective}",
1056            "",
1057            "## Acceptance Criteria",
1058        ]
1059        for c in task.acceptance_criteria:
1060            lines.append(f"- {c}")
1061        if task.constraints:
1062            lines.append("")
1063            lines.append("## Constraints")
1064            for c in task.constraints:
1065                lines.append(f"- {c}")
1066        if task.required_skills:
1067            lines.append("")
1068            lines.append("## Required Skills")
1069            for s in task.required_skills:
1070                lines.append(f"- {s}")
1071        if "howlframe-app-development" in (task.required_skills or []):
1072            lines.append("")
1073            lines.append("## HowlFrame Application Guidance")
1074            lines.append("- Build & test commands: `bash scripts/build.sh`, `bash scripts/test.sh`")
1075            lines.append("- Standalone bytecode VM runs under capability gates (`network,database,filesystem`).")
1076            lines.append("- Single root form (`http_server`, `web_app`, `cli_app`, or `module`) per `.howl` file.")
1077            lines.append("- Handle fallible parsing/io using `try_let`.")
1078        return "\n".join(lines)
1079
1080    def _build_remediation_prompt(
1081        self,
1082        task: TaskSpec,
1083        diff_content: str,
1084        findings: List[ReviewFinding],
1085    ) -> str:
1086        """Constructs an actionable remediation prompt with confirmed defect evidence."""
1087        lines = [
1088            f"# Remediation Request for Task `{task.task_id}`",
1089            f"**Objective:** {task.objective}",
1090            "",
1091            "## Identified Defects to Remediate",
1092        ]
1093        for f in findings:
1094            lines.append(f"### [{f.severity.upper()}] {f.title} ({f.reviewer_role})")
1095            if f.location:
1096                lines.append(f"- **Location:** `{f.location}`")
1097            if f.claim:
1098                lines.append(f"- **Claim:** {f.claim}")
1099            if f.evidence:
1100                lines.append(f"- **Evidence / Failure Case:** {f.evidence}")
1101            if f.suggested_fix:
1102                lines.append(f"- **Suggested Fix:** {f.suggested_fix}")
1103            lines.append("")
1104
1105        lines.extend([
1106            "## Current Implementation Diff",
1107            "```diff",
1108            diff_content,
1109            "```",
1110            "",
1111            "## Instructions",
1112            "Fix the reported defects in the repository. Ensure all edge cases and tests pass.",
1113        ])
1114        return "\n".join(lines)
1115
1116    def _render_summary_markdown(
1117        self,
1118        task: TaskSpec,
1119        routing: RoutingDecision,
1120        delta: RepositoryDelta,
1121        review_cycles: List[ReviewCycleResult],
1122        verif_plan: VerificationPlan,
1123        remediation_count: int,
1124        hf_status: Optional[str],
1125    ) -> str:
1126        lines = [
1127            f"# Governed Task Run Summary: `{task.task_id}`",
1128            "",
1129            "## Overview",
1130            f"- **Objective:** {task.objective}",
1131            f"- **Repository:** {self.target_repo.name}",
1132            f"- **Final State:** `{task.current_state.upper()}`",
1133            f"- **Implementing Agent:** {routing.selected_agent_name} (`{routing.selected_agent_id}`)",
1134            f"- **Reasoning Tier:** {routing.reasoning_tier}",
1135            f"- **HowlFrame Shadow Audit:** {hf_status or 'N/A'}",
1136            "",
1137            "## Repository Changes",
1138            f"- **Files Added:** {len(delta.files_added)}",
1139            f"- **Files Modified:** {len(delta.files_modified)}",
1140            f"- **Files Deleted:** {len(delta.files_deleted)}",
1141            f"- **Total Insertions:** +{delta.insertions}",
1142            f"- **Total Deletions:** -{delta.deletions}",
1143            "",
1144            "## Review & Remediation",
1145            f"- **Total Review Cycles:** {len(review_cycles)}",
1146            f"- **Remediation Cycles:** {remediation_count}",
1147        ]
1148        if review_cycles:
1149            last_cycle = review_cycles[-1]
1150            lines.append(f"- **Final Review Status:** `{last_cycle.status}`")
1151            for role, res in sorted(last_cycle.reviewer_results.items()):
1152                lines.append(f"  - `{role}`: {res.status} ({len(res.findings)} findings)")
1153
1154        lines.extend([
1155            "",
1156            "## Deterministic Verification",
1157            f"- **Overall Status:** `{verif_plan.overall_status.upper()}`",
1158        ])
1159        for step in verif_plan.steps:
1160            mark = "✓" if step.status == "verified" else "✗"
1161            lines.append(f"- [{mark}] **{step.name}** (`{step.category}`): {step.status} (exit {step.exit_code})")
1162
1163        lines.extend([
1164            "",
1165            "---",
1166            "*Verified and sealed by HowlPlane AI Engineering Control Plane.*",
1167        ])
1168        return "\n".join(lines)

Drives the end-to-end governed engineering lifecycle, maintaining strict control over state transitions, adversarial reviews, remediation loops, verification gates, and human authority boundaries.

GovernedTaskOrchestrator( target_repo: Union[str, pathlib.Path], control_plane_root: Union[str, pathlib.Path, NoneType] = None, config: Optional[OrchestrationConfig] = None) 
150    def __init__(
151        self,
152        target_repo: Union[str, Path],
153        control_plane_root: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
154        config: Optional[OrchestrationConfig] = None,
155    ):
156        self.target_repo = Path(target_repo).resolve()
157        self.control_plane_root = (
158            Path(control_plane_root).resolve()
159            if control_plane_root
160            else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
161        )
162        self.config = config or OrchestrationConfig()
163        ledger_path = str(self.control_plane_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "evidence_ledger.jsonl")
164        self.ledger = EvidenceLedger(ledger_path)
target_repo
control_plane_root
config
ledger
def prepare_task_plan( self, task_spec: TaskSpec, planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> Tuple[ProjectContext, RoutingDecision, VerificationPlan, pathlib.Path, Optional[Any]]: 
205    def prepare_task_plan(
206        self,
207        task_spec: TaskSpec,
208        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
209    ) -> Tuple[ProjectContext, RoutingDecision, VerificationPlan, Path, Optional[Any]]:
210        """Prepares task run directory, project discovery, routing, verification plan, and review briefs."""
211        run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
212        run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
213        (run_dir / "reviews").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
214        (run_dir / "remediation").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
215
216        ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(self.target_repo)
217        (run_dir / "project_context.json").write_text(ctx.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
218
219        router = TaskRouter()
220        routing = router.route(task_spec)
221        (run_dir / "route.json").write_text(json.dumps(asdict(routing), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
222
223        verif_plan = ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(ctx, task_id=task_spec.task_id)
224        (run_dir / "verification_plan.json").write_text(verif_plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
225
226        task_spec.recommended_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
227        task_spec.actual_agent = routing.selected_agent_id
228        task_spec.is_override = routing.is_override
229        task_spec.override_reason = routing.rationale if routing.is_override else None
230        if task_spec.current_state == "discovered":
231            task_spec.transition_to("planned", "Task routed and verification plan generated")
232        task_spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
233        skill_ctx = build_skill_context(task_spec)
234        for role_id in routing.recommended_reviewers:
235            role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
236            if role:
237                (run_dir / "reviews" / f"{role_id}.md").write_text(
238                    role.render_brief(task=task_spec, diff_content="", context=skill_ctx), encoding="utf-8"
239                )
240        (run_dir / "findings_template.yaml").write_text("# Review Findings Template\nfindings: []\n", encoding="utf-8")
241
242        hf_res = None
243        if self.config.enable_howlframe_audit:
244            try:
245                hf_res = HowlFrameAuditRunner.run_audit(
246                    context=ctx,
247                    record_evidence=self.config.record_evidence,
248                    task_id=task_spec.task_id,
249                    ledger=self.ledger,
250                    dogfood_mode="shadow",
251                )
252                (run_dir / "howlframe_audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(hf_res.to_dict(), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
253            except Exception:
254                pass
255
256        # Check pre-execution human authority boundary and bind HowlChangeOps decision if applicable
257        pre_b = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate_pre_execution(
258            task=task_spec,
259            planned_actions=planned_actions,
260            target_repo=self.target_repo,
261        )
262        self._bind_decision_packet(pre_b, run_dir)
263        if pre_b.requires_human_approval and pre_b.decision_packet:
264            (run_dir / "decision_packet.md").write_text(pre_b.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
265
266        return ctx, routing, verif_plan, run_dir, hf_res

Prepares task run directory, project discovery, routing, verification plan, and review briefs.

def run( self, task_spec: TaskSpec, planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> OrchestrationResult: 
284    def run(
285        self,
286        task_spec: TaskSpec,
287        planned_actions: Optional[List[str]] = None,
288    ) -> OrchestrationResult:
289        """
290        Executes the complete governed control-plane loop for the task under
291        mutual-exclusion locks and durable checkpoint guarantees.
292        """
293        start_time = time.time()
294
295        # Acquire Locks if enabled
296        repo_lock = (
297            RepoLock(self.target_repo, task_spec.task_id, command=f"ai work {task_spec.task_id} --execute")
298            if self.config.acquire_locks
299            else None
300        )
301        task_lock = (
302            TaskLock(self.target_repo, task_spec.task_id, operation="orchestrate")
303            if self.config.acquire_locks
304            else None
305        )
306
307        if repo_lock:
308            repo_lock.acquire()
309        if task_lock:
310            task_lock.acquire()
311
312        try:
313            return self._run_governed_loop(task_spec, planned_actions, start_time)
314        except Exception as exc:
315            run_dir = self.target_repo / ".task_runs" / task_spec.task_id
316            if run_dir.is_dir():
317                try:
318                    CheckpointManager.record_interrupted(
319                        run_dir, stage=task_spec.current_state, reason=str(exc)
320                    )
321                except Exception:
322                    pass
323            raise
324        finally:
325            if task_lock:
326                task_lock.release()
327            if repo_lock:
328                repo_lock.release()

Executes the complete governed control-plane loop for the task under mutual-exclusion locks and durable checkpoint guarantees.
